Representative Greene wasn’t even using a dog whistle — it was a bullhorn, putting a racist target on my back to her MAGA supporters.

| Hey Peter, it’s Congressman Jamaal Bowman. I just want to make one thing clear:

In her press conference in front of countless reporters Marjorie Taylor Greene said something incredibly dangerous — calling me “aggressive” and saying she feels “threatened” by me.

**Representative Greene wasn’t even using a dog whistle — it was a bullhorn, putting a racist target on my back to her MAGA supporters.** It echoes what happened with Emmett Till and with Mike Brown, and unfortunately this country has a history of characterizing Black men who are outspoken, who stand their ground, or who push back as being “threatening” or “intimidating.”

Marjorie Taylor Greene is a white supremacist. Describing somebody’s beliefs – which are clear for everybody to see — isn’t “like calling a person of color the n word,” no matter what false equivalencies she might draw.

This behavior is dangerous and reckless — but we can’t let it stop our movement for progressive change.

**That's why we have to ask:[ We must ALL continue to speak truth to power, and I’ll keep standing up to right-wing extremists. Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots at Florida?

It's because he HATES what we're doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we're fighting back with freedom.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I can turn it around.

The American people know it, too. That's why they are ALREADY voting with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot--but I need your support. ** **

We sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither on the vine in many places in our country.

But Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the world went mad.

We held the line when freedom hung in the balance.

We showed that we can -- and must -- revitalize America.

**I believe freedom is worth fighting for, and as your next President I promise I will never stop fighting for your freedom.** **[Will you fight alongside me?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7debd687cb904cbda1a7787959a20e9c&_e=qNpmaaTZDZ2QsF-fR7sdAvkcx2w84USp5nDjfMy6SDfgUeDQ6w61ijP5eI2zLhljCQ2OicIxqAAR-20iW1sq8657o0925Iwyp2wis_y5Hlw_uNT-IMWcSPc0S0JiaglQsMHqFUmfe_UuNbkf5B2x6eDD8KAzk87OmYZL3lHp9QFP4hqLOilvAPlrs1KTVlS-pLqae9fwc4eHs7NUSJNtxweb49QtFfr3vObcFzvbgIiR3R7lQIbgpNMJjS2cEKkq9_4hnQzQ2oQ9Uo53KM-QjMW4fSp6c3t-A3dAYaoGAAsu74AwcS8Z45PEh8oIZ6wwA9_TRWq7I0RxK0jrVI9xH36I95Gk3lUKlQpnkGaivXa3VfBYqsaX7BmNcvUA8prTnKlq6Z2uj6-VXTtycMn4qW-M8VDaQ2qhwN9g-tVbKafFIbZzfc0VKb2CpGJSlYpz "Will you fight alongside me?")**

I'll make sure we have an economy that works for working families, a secure border that works for our nation, and so much more. The battle won't be easy and will require a lot of toil and sweat to get it all done. I'm excited to share my agenda for America with you over the course of this campaign.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

This email will probably be a bit longer than others you receive today,
but it’s really important and I hope you’ll read the entire message.

Justice Democrats was started by just a handful of Bernie 2016 staffers
and super volunteers. We had just worked on this inspiring campaign for
president. Bernie put a progressive agenda front and center for millions
of people for the first time — myself included.

In 2018, when Justice Democrats recruited AOC to run, she was working as a
bartender — she even worked as a bartender for many months while running
for office. Sometimes, that’s what it takes when you’re a working-class
candidate.

We helped AOC manage her team, run her organizing program, and make
everything we could of our small budget. Then, she won. We toppled one of
the most powerful corporate Democrats and elected the youngest woman ever
to serve in Congress in his place.

Money has always been one of the biggest things holding us back from doing
more. It’s the one thing that our establishment opponents have a seemingly
endless supply of and that we’re always working hard to raise just a
fraction of what they can raise.

Since January 2021, our fundraising has been in a slow but steady decline
and it really isn’t sustainable for us as an organization. Here’s a
screenshot from our actual ActBlue dashboard:

We don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, so we rely on supporters like
you to power our work.

Thank you so much for being a part of our movement to challenge the entire
political establishment and elect more progressive change-makers.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/134568?refcode=em20230524-29112&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=29112%2E1203867%2ETMEe0g ]→ Will you now dig deep and make your first contribution of
$3 right now to support our critical work?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/134568?refcode=em20230524-29112&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=29112%2E1203867%2ETMEe0g ]Contribute $3

I know we can do amazing things together. I’m grateful to be in this fight
with you, thank you again.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas, Executive Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1022&akid=29112%2E1203867%2ETMEe0g ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1023&akid=29112%2E1203867%2ETMEe0g ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

subject: No more speculation. I’M IN.

body:
I wanted you to be one of the first people to know about this.
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://trk.secureandprosper.-RVtdWOPQ2r5ieW0Fo4g)
---
Friend,

It's official: I'M IN.

**I'm running for President of the United States. **
---
| | [JOIN ME](http://trk.secureandprosper.-crXB8RKGMZ-d2WoiWjg)
---
Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots at Florida?

It’s because he HATES what we’re doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we’re fighting back with freedom.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I can turn it around.

The American people know it, too. That’s why they are ALREADY voting with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot—but I need your support. ** **
---
| [](http://trk.secureandprosper._7sCEJA)
---
We sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither on the vine in many places in our country.

But Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the world went mad.

We held the line when freedom hung in the balance.

We showed that we can — and must — revitalize America.

**I believe freedom is worth fighting for, and as your next President I promise I will never stop fighting for your freedom.** **[Will you fight alongside me?](http://trk.secureandprosper. "Will you fight alongside me?")**
---
| | [YES, I’M READY TO WIN](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
And we can win, Friend.

I'll make sure we have an economy that works for working families, a secure border that works for our nation, and so much more. The battle won’t be easy and will require a lot of toil and sweat to get it all done. I’m excited to share my agenda for America with you over the course of this campaign.

**But here’s why I’m writing you today, Friend:[I want to ask you to become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first team tele-townhall.](http://trk.secureandprosper.-dW_rZHr4XQtTSvMg "I want to ask you to become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first Team Teletownhall.")**

I promise you, unlike other campaigns, our grassroots fundraising program is built on the principle that our donors are a part of our team, not our personal piggybank.

**_[I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.](http://trk.secureandprosper.-5LiefZAu9d0nhg "I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.")_**

Can I count on you?
---
| | [DONATE NOW](http://trk.secureandprosper.-9iYA)
---
| [](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
In Freedom,

Ron DeSantis
---
_P.S I want to show you my appreciation for standing with me from Day 1 of this campaign. It’s why my team prepared gifts to thank our Day 1 donors.

If you chip in $47 by midnight on 5/25, we’ll send you a limited-edition Day 1 membership card and an invite to our first-ever team tele-townhall.

Make sure you get yours now at this secure link: **[https://dsnts.com/aexHpu](http://trk.secureandprosper.)**_
---
|

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he graduated with honors and was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School. While at Harvard, he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a federal prosecutor, where he targeted and convicted child predators. He was elected to Congress in 2012 and advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory. Congressman DeSantis was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award winning television host. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

From schools to banks, grocery stores to malls, Americans are forced every day to contend with the reality that the next mass shooting could be at any place, in any state. **But it doesn’t have to be this way. Contact: [Press@HuffinesLiberty.com](mailto:Press@HuffinesLiberty.com)
## **Liberty Report: Invisible Tyranny, Texas-Style**
## _Occupational Licensing hurts the working class and is bad for business. Why is it still around?_
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-zydirx-yuddtktydi-y/) DALLAS, TX, May 24, 2023 -- Tyranny is exercised in all sorts of creative ways. Sometimes we feel it overtly, as often is the case when government circumscribes our liberty. But sometimes tyrannical forces remain hidden or are simply baked into a system we long ago accepted and no longer question.Occupational licensing does not exactly grab headlines, but it should. You see, if you work in any number of fields--HVAC contractor, manicurist, barber, plumber, travel guide, real estate agent, auctioneer, teacher, shampooer--your "occupation" is regulated by the state of Texas. You must obtain a license to operate. And often, you must be re-licensed every number of years. If you refuse to meet the state-imposed rules, you cannot legally practice in your field.[**My weekly column in the Dallas Express discusses the invisible tyranny that is occupational licenses. **](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-zydirx-yuddtktydi-j/)Reducing occupational licensing is about more than economics, though; it is also about liberty. Consider Shelley Luther and her employees, whose licenses were threatened by Texas Gov. Greg Abbott when she reopened her salon during the COVID shutdown. Or the 17 restaurants and bars whose licenses were suspended in June 2020 for operating above government-imposed capacity limits! Do you know what the Jan 6th detainees do every night from the confines of their jail cells?

Friend,

Do you know what the Jan 6th detainees do every night from the confines of their jail cells?

**They sing the national anthem.**

And they have sung this song proudly every night for _more than 700 straight nights_. This song is more than just a sign of their patriotism. It’s an exercise in their freedom of speech, even from the depths of the D.C. gulag.

We captured that audio and had the greatest President, Donald J. Trump, recite the Pledge of Allegiance. Then we combined those recordings to create a song you need to hear. All net proceeds from the song go to certain Jan 6 families in need.

**The song, Justice for All, is number 1 on the Billboard Digital Charts!**

name: Trump News HQ
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9dh62kvl7lfhog3bfpdqso1853dvtos1co9fhg8_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1g61o75cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zeu0kb2m5a2ets3em6qvhqo5f1err33t2gufn520_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1g61o75cjh2bs) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg7f1kbumq5rv8t3lev2nl1js0f23kv5debtr8po_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1g61o75cjh2bs) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Dear
Friend,

I hear
from people all the time that Thomas Sowell is one of their
heroes. For those people-and you may be among them-I'm thrilled
to share a digital copy of one of his commentaries with you,
absolutely free: "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts for the
Rich."

"Tax cuts
for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower
tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy
Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the
federal government?

Hoover
Institution Senior Fellow Thomas Sowell takes an empirical
approach in his commentary, "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts
for the Rich."

Sowell
separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses
real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all
actually lead to greater revenue for the government.

subject: An announcement that should bring a smile to your face and hope to your heart: former federal prosecutor, Will Rollins just announced his campaign for Congress in California’s 41st district -- one of the most important races in the country in the effort by Democrats to retake the House.
body:
Retaking the House runs through CA-41
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Taa1fce8c-c3c5-4335-b1ab-f8155beabdf0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

|
---
| |
---
| | | | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T437e7850-7cd0-4cbf-8d16-c8ada0ba3185/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I’ve got a huge announcement that should bring a smile to your face and hope to your heart: former federal prosecutor, Will Rollins just announced his campaign for Congress in California’s 41st district -- one of the most important races in the country in the effort by Democrats to retake the House. Will stunned political experts in 2022 when he came so close to winning against right wing Republican, Ken Calvert. It ended up being one of the closest races in the country. He outperformed every projection and was the only Democratic challenger in California to win the independent vote. That’s a big deal. There is no question in my mind that in this upcoming election, with the Presidency on the ballot, the larger turnout will be the key to victory IF we have a strong campaign. I have committed my energy, time and money to this race and today I am asking you to start Will off with a show of support that will send him a message that we are behind him 100 percent. [I’ll share more about why I'm backing Will, but first, I have an important request: Could you split a $10 donation between Will’s campaign and Blue Amp Action to help him launch with strength? Will can win this thing, so please donate now.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T432fe97d-c49c-404b-9cba-21c6a7707edf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
|
---
| | | | | | [**DONATE NOW**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfc0f1551-adce-4316-83c0-a4ab0775a7e6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| Here’s why Democrats across the country should pay close attention to this race: 1\. We need candidates like Will in Congress. As a former federal prosecutor, he understands the ongoing danger that extremism poses to our democracy. He brought justice to insurrectionists, and I know he'll take the oath to defend democracy as seriously now as he did in the Justice Department. 2\. Retaking the House runs through CA-41. After the new lines were drawn, CA-41 became a true swing seat. It’s the type of district Democrats MUST WIN to regain Congress. 3\. GOP super PACs. Despite the tough midterm environment in 2022, Will was the third most “overperforming” Dem challenger in the country. He was also heavily outspent by the GOP’s dark money machine. If Democrats help Will keep pace, he can flip this seat! 4\. Will’s opponent Ken Calvert has got to go. Calvert voted to overturn the 2020 presidential election. He backs the extreme ban on abortion -- including for instances of rape, and wants doctors who perform them to go to jail. CA-41 is home to one of the most LGBTQ-friendly cities in Palm Springs, yet Calvert staunchly opposes gay marriage. The rematch is on, folks. Will came so close to winning in 2022, and this is our chance to finish the job. But it depends on widespread, grassroots support. [Please split a $10 contribution between Will Rollins’ campaign for Congress and Blue Amp Action today. I’m telling you, this will be one of the most critical races in the country, so don’t sit this one out! We need lots of Democrats to step up right out of the gate.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1544e047-9ee5-4f80-9e05-ebe8cebb772e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thanks, Barbara Boxer Former U.S. Senator, California

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! name: Freedom Nation Today
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ba5078c0574842da98f8d8dcdefd97bb&_e=BN6jxZCbK1Blzt1a069wltFcGVSsx8_810hP-6mpZDV2DelK972BLLG-TSEYTuSnUv6cYVLCX3EQbAsOPg9_egZKgPvGm-K0rtBTw_wf_zS0xHr4c4uEwJ_oJhy0o5UYEuCZYY58oQYEgZhNHgRyif5hI4stsnq8vLFKWk_2tjwNEH5uoJ6Mlt4Bk8lpxyB0UH2cDFrC46f8tc-_wccRMOu-zscRi1Lq6VdyrVBpFOiVWPp0x5KJy-HHPiG5sxqaCT7OrSw1aCmHBWECDFKHpM9Y8N325AbMVwPow8OauYBMaSaWotUo_IdPwBNKBj8J12zJ-ZnBNF_s4j56ufXMk-dyHmiovFwthFj4tyg_mFLsIsQFY2ZxEfWagOHnC0hmEX4-9JqFxLgJUkevHG_oSw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ba5078c0574842da98f8d8dcdefd97bb&_e=BN6jxZCbK1Blzt1a069wltFcGVSsx8_810hP-6mpZDV2DelK972BLLG-TSEYTuSnUv6cYVLCX3EQbAsOPg9_egZKgPvGm-K0rtBTw_wf_zS0xHr4c4uEwJ_oJhy0o5UYEuCZYY58oQYEgZhNHgRyif5hI4stsnq8vLFKWk_2tjwNEH5uoJ6Mlt4Bk8lpxyB0UH2cDFrC46f8tc-_wccRMOu-zscRi1Lq6VdyrVBpFOiVWPp0x5KJy-HHPiG5sxqaza4Js5b11oIAhIpwDtwqyB85G779ZpDwqgmWlxqKvngwrRIjvDuFH2TZLyw0mTL69qeboBcg5LZmbumqzHPW-tvROMvWQgT16Jx-VC1-ynrYiz__SlWOSvzUlqpKjTG4piUHAkGxSU6bWV8Ahn6c2A%3D%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ba5078c0574842da98f8d8dcdefd97bb&_e=BN6jxZCbK1Blzt1a069wltFcGVSsx8_810hP-6mpZDV2DelK972BLLG-TSEYTuSnUv6cYVLCX3EQbAsOPg9_egZKgPvGm-K0rtBTw_wf_zS0xHr4c4uEwJ_oJhy0o5UYEuCZYY58oQYEgZhNHgRyif5hI4stsnq8vLFKWk_2tjwNEH5uoJ6Mlt4Bk8lpxyB0UH2cDFrC46f8tc-_wccRMOu-zscRi1Lq6VdyrVBpFOiVWPp0x5KJy-HHPiG5sxqaozvh3KUuB9eHPAhgelkHawZdDPSDzltmIBI56rjrKsAXyS9Z2e4yZ50_je1Z4BJkJINjviuN7_Df2hzUmSqQKPTb7lkuElsFt-cqsT4tC7JAyXeJkGN3seCFmGUo5Bx95J683ibn86LHLBZ6o1d3Rg%3D%3D) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

## American Markets in the Red Again
The Dow Jones Industrial Average [has fallen](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzFvgzAQBeBfYzbQ-Q7jZPDQhS1dOyLHPgc3Jo7gGpR_X9G52yc96T29r8t08bnkx-3TL-wk1ckHyS-ewLRoWqQJm-gSMzI17PRwMqD7E1AzO07GMiHZdAaDWtvAmhDPpkcGGqjJDgEJDBoNgJq6gfqoU4J4td5CCqoHjlnq2n3X_JCZU3nXF69dqEtT3Czy3BR9KBwVjvu-d-FxDUeocDyqFY5gDh_apIZ7u_j1ztJKjf7dlvzi9ucZvfDWzbKUZnXxuedS8jZY1cNt8bn8rcn_538DAAD__7IVWPI) for four straight days. Economic uncertainty is running rampant in the markets, and it's being fueled by the US government's failure to reach a debt ceiling agreement. As the Treasury Department warns of running out of cash, fears of a default and an ensuing recession rise. "_There are real concerns that this could go right down to the wire, and investors are slowly gearing up accordingly,_ " said Deutsche Bank's Jim Reid, [commenting](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ8Gd0TLgn9SUHyNu3ztldbGu8Qk2PgMSpS3P-Xqq2ekkebrMl0oprjd_tMqvoY80VzjUyZoNbYa7YQN-yCCYhvxphtaMG4A2yweZtMRATOTvcJMRhxeAfAcBmAX-iZ6BLTQYmsA0NhTZx2bEICvPfUQZuVAONZ8nO45bnWRkN75KcdpzmuT_FLrXpT9p3BUOBaRR9xulPaFPoLCcZNXUTjac-_c0OtS8_zQKx0PqfrDdM1Mb132FkBzful73qTojQrTd3N43l8xpVi6Xjm4rRTTb7n-PeInAAD__9KHX8E) on the political showdown's effect on the market. Speaker Kevin McCarthy defended his insistence on a spending cut in a press conference yesterday. "_I just think it 's common sense. It's reasonable and it's rational that we spend less next year than we spend this year. Every household would do this."_

The governor leaned on his record in Florida during his pitch to America, mentioning his state's staunch resistance to Covid tyranny and attempting to chart a similar path forward for the nation: "_We chose facts over fear, education over indoctrination, law and order over rioting and disorder. We held the line when freedom hung in the balance. We showed that we can -- and must -- revitalize America_." ## Tina Turner Dead at 83
The Queen of Rock 'n' Roll [died yesterday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFugzAQgOGnMZvRccaYDh66sKVrR3TgM7gydkSuQXn7qp07_8MvfZ-3-UYpp7J90MFeYp1plfTkGaxGq9HM2AQfmZFNw74bRgtdP4Jpds9utTSA5RB5WW1A5xCWxS3BvY2OYpM8AhqwaDsA7Ew7mD50MUJYHDmIq-qBQ5J6tl81Fdk55ld98tmu9Wiy30XuD2XeFU4Kp-u62hfttf5WhRMX4VMolYOLKJwkFdLyfRY-dWAKmkTTxno0GjsYwPZj3-5y5Ob04X6lnNNjcKqH7aCU_5byv8BPAAAA__-H21zr). She passed away in her home near Zurich, Switzerland, from complications of a long battle with illness. Turner, whose real name was Anna Mae Bullock, learned to sing in her Baptist church in Brownsville, Tennessee. She went on to win eight Grammy awards and land twelve songs in the Top 40\. Her first release, _A Fool in Love,_ hit #2 in the charts in 1960 and catapulted [a career that lasted](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7Fy8yAQBOCnQR2a4w4ku6D4G3X-25QaYg75Mkh4ELYmb59R6rS7xe73cZtvQbJsy_-wsm-pzOHe5M0zOI1OI83YRZ-Ykaljb4aLA2MvQN3DU6BEV0cYIjAEduZKIxBbgIFiMp14BCRw6AwAGuoHstGkBPFzDCOku7LAUVqp_VeRrT045e_y5trfy9pl_2jtuSv6p3BSOB3H0Vd-Na772Z9JqTkqnHbZFq66yRZ0e9WNq47Cuw4LR30hfb7QJ8gqnLrq4_OQnGUfRmVhWYPk38H2t_8nAAD__5r8WkY) until 2009. Tina suffered in an abusive marriage to former bandmate Ike Turner, and after her divorce she made her comeback to music in the 80's on MTV. Max Lousada, a Warner Music executive, had this to say about Turner: _" Even after the countless awards, the 180 million album sales, the record-breaking tours, and unforgettable acting roles, Tina will be remembered most through the sheer joy of her music."_

name: Conservatives Give
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6f85e1a9480f42e79cc1035d5afd4107&_e=UT9w1qcpMHS4Yoc1_4yQAYTtdyKjKPXVmiDWv8E7lwYXLatHNDPr9kZdLE5WJEsecFk9pECoR0urHR5HViNbago0Gp8NMbX_g3pmQyPXEIF21k_SOJzJ_95aOi3CskhiL5ir6hiXw-vwvWljd7BNLsCw22yQqr-dZHBVyY20UTaM6-yVtk1KYjLIzfZeNd1fQaHYd0KfAjqN231eZgVFNkijTgpRIvwFtrx0JBpteIWIfDWScb5gSa5nRoSpA_5Dr9bHvjPVlbLMMowY31TY1fXJechKGZ_dmtSRIU99vYABGolZirxN94pESCmUTHq--RUtsNeX3cbDbMFAQ1xt2zu9SgGI77oi_J42rBZ4YmvW0594QsovhQJvseLXP_G0-PICVt-Z0WaDrf6vYRngiA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6f85e1a9480f42e79cc1035d5afd4107&_e=UT9w1qcpMHS4Yoc1_4yQAYTtdyKjKPXVmiDWv8E7lwYXLatHNDPr9kZdLE5WJEsecFk9pECoR0urHR5HViNbago0Gp8NMbX_g3pmQyPXEIF21k_SOJzJ_95aOi3CskhiL5ir6hiXw-vwvWljd7BNLsCw22yQqr-dZHBVyY20UTaM6-yVtk1KYjLIzfZeNd1fQaHYd0KfAjqN231eZgVFNkijTgpRIvwFtrx0JBpteIWIfDWScb5gSa5nRoSpA_5D9wl_BfrM-vuZkx4LCsGr3iwHUnNUd2XjYJmjasug6PJcJrBYGRleFkjQ2xeLp5IWhTGgkdLxPq9MqfonSiDeZkqlnFXzsm-iM_WEzqXxIk7iY7jQHZB9eyFnOPDXjVqbCvPNQ07hrqAYr2u4FyhPlQ%3D%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6f85e1a9480f42e79cc1035d5afd4107&_e=UT9w1qcpMHS4Yoc1_4yQAYTtdyKjKPXVmiDWv8E7lwYXLatHNDPr9kZdLE5WJEsecFk9pECoR0urHR5HViNbago0Gp8NMbX_g3pmQyPXEIF21k_SOJzJ_95aOi3CskhiL5ir6hiXw-vwvWljd7BNLsCw22yQqr-dZHBVyY20UTaM6-yVtk1KYjLIzfZeNd1fQaHYd0KfAjqN231eZgVFNkijTgpRIvwFtrx0JBpteIWIfDWScb5gSa5nRoSpA_5DYgS2DBey9XhplMFILkuG2I8i8nmnhi5y7Bv7iW1EVbSeJyDRRVMVEMTWhaxzbp7x9x2t-0QaRc2KzRuGQ5m7XfXqrwv4V2Nx-8BZSOCE4corwTnbMFWNqC0mc0mKSRAz4b3y8it9BaZXhD4gkjhTiA%3D%3D) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: Yes: I’m running for president, and this is why
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWSYLwJDvN

I wanted you to be one of the first people to know about this.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWSYLwJDvN

Friend,

It's official: I'M IN.

I'm
running for President of the United States.

JOIN ME

Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots
at Florida?

It's because he HATES what we're doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we're fighting back with
freedom.

Joe
Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I
can turn it around.

The
American people know it, too. That's why they are ALREADY voting
with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of
Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot-but I need your
support.

We
sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after
the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither
on the vine in many places in our country.

But
Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose
education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over
rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the
world went mad.

We
held the line when freedom hung in the balance.

We
showed that we can - and must - revitalize America.

I
believe freedom is worth fighting for, and as your next President
I promise I will never stop fighting for your freedom. Will you
fight alongside me?

YES, I'M READY TO WIN

And
we can win, friend.

I'll make sure we have an economy that works for working
families, a secure border that works for our nation, and so much
more. The battle won't be easy and will require a lot of toil and
sweat to get it all done. I'm excited to share my agenda for
America with you over the course of this campaign.

But
here's why I'm writing you today, friend: I want to ask you to
become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join
our first team tele-townhall.

I
promise you, unlike other campaigns, our grassroots fundraising
program is built on the principle that our donors are a part of
our team, not our personal piggybank.

I
vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake
matches, and no lies.

Can
I count on you?

DONATE NOW

In
Freedom,

Ron
DeSantis

P.S
I want to show you my appreciation for standing with me from Day
1 of this campaign. It's why my team prepared gifts to thank our
Day 1 donors.

If
you chip in $47 by midnight on 5/25, we'll send you a
limited-edition Day 1 membership card and an invite to our
first-ever team tele-townhall.

Make sure you get yours now at this secure link:
https://dsnts.com/aexHpu

Meet Ron DeSantis

A native Floridian with
blue-collar roots, Ron attended Dunedin High School and worked
his way through Yale University, where he graduated with honors
and was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also
graduated with honors from Harvard Law School. While at Harvard,
he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During
his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a
U.S. Navy SEAL commander in support of the SEAL mission in
Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military
decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service
and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron
also served as a federal prosecutor, where he targeted and
convicted child predators. He was elected to Congress in 2012 and
advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget
amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose
malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their
authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion
conspiracy theory. Congressman DeSantis was also a leading
champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the
VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

Ron
is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award winning television
host. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters,
Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

charitable contributions for federal income tax purposes.
Contributions from corporations, foreign nationals (without

banks are prohibited. Federal law requires us to use our best

occupation, and name of employer for each individual whose
aggregate contributions exceed $200 in a calendar year. The
maximum that an individual may contribute is $6,600
($3,300/primary & $3,300/general). The maximum that a couple
using a joint account may contribute is $13,200 ($6,600/primary &
$6,600/general). A federal multi-candidate PAC may contribute
$10,000 ($5,000/primary & $5,000/general).

Contribution rules

## American Markets in the Red Again
The Dow Jones Industrial Average [has fallen](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uhDAQBOCnMZ2Rvf4BChdp6C5tSuSf5XDOnE-wAd3bR6RP90kjzWi-btPN55Kf90-_oqO5Tj5SPnA6YBKGg-GgJmiSmxEBVYNO2t4IOSihm8WBVX2wOFtrjNGoBz-LoDs7APTgfWiyAwFKGDBSKiu7NgqFnR50MF3odZJMC0yZ6tZ-1_ykBefyrgdubaxrU9xC9NqZ-mAwMhjP82zjM8QrZDBe1QxGYS5f2qnGB1_99kDiVJN_85IP5D-v5An3dqG1NJtLrzOXknfbMS3uq8_lb43-_f8bAAD__x6PWyI) for four straight days. Tina suffered in an abusive marriage to former bandmate Ike Turner, and after her divorce she made her comeback to music in the 80's on MTV. body:
Join us to elect 240 House and 16 Senate Republicans in NH for a fiscally secure future.

| | | | | [](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fexpand-majorities/1/0100018852ca750c-9bab0ab6-37b2-44aa-94fa-57fadbeedb24-000000/Thtg_Qw8egCz2Ge-_raOqZDXsbo=323)
---
| | Derek,

As founder and chair of Granite Solutions, I'm privileged to share with you our vision, dedication, and our urgent goals as we set our sights on the future of New Hampshire.

Our mission at Granite Solutions is to support the election of fiscally conservative candidates at the local and state levels. We understand that the prosperity of our state is dependent on careful management of our resources and a commitment to economic prudence. Reckless spending cannot be the way forward, and it is our aim to advocate for policies and candidates that share this belief.

As we get ready for the 2024 election, our goals are ambitious yet essential. We are focused on electing 240 House Republicans and 16 Senate Republicans in the state of New Hampshire. Why these numbers, you might ask? It's simple. 240 State Representatives are needed to secure a thriving and functioning Republican majority in the House and 16 Republican State Senators will put the Democrats further in the minority in the state senate and prevent that chamber flipping in future cycles, giving us the power to enact the fiscally responsible policies our state needs to thrive.

But we cannot achieve this without your help. Your support and contributions are crucial in helping us achieve this goal. It’s a lofty target, but with your support, it’s a reachable one. I firmly believe that with your contributions and active involvement in our mission, we can sway the scales in favor of fiscal responsibility and prudence.

I am committed to steering Granite Solutions in this direction and I'm hopeful you'll join us in our journey. [Your contribution of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 can make a significant impact on our advocacy efforts and candidate support.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fdonate/1/0100018852ca750c-9bab0ab6-37b2-44aa-94fa-57fadbeedb24-000000/p6HdTAj0unu3rpaos2D-Or0VHsc=323)

Now more than ever, we need strong fiscal conservatives in our state government. With the increasing tendency towards reckless spending in D.C., it's critical that we hold the line here in New Hampshire. We must champion Granite Solutions to ensure a thriving and prosperous future for our state.

Your continued support means the world to us, and I can’t thank you enough for being a part of our mission. [Together, let's make a difference for the future of New Hampshire.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fdonate/2/0100018852ca750c-9bab0ab6-37b2-44aa-94fa-57fadbeedb24-000000/1Gpg3Ja7m7gwAmOXbEkpOFtC2vk=323)

Best regards,

Rep. Joe Sweeney
Founder and Chair, Granite Solutions

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=7f83dc9a8c&e=84ee529f47)

Friend,

It's official: I'M IN.

**I'm running for President of the United States.**
---
| | [JOIN ME](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=928173d688&e=84ee529f47)
---
Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots at Florida?

It’s because he HATES what we’re doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we’re fighting back with freedom.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I can turn it around.

The American people know it, too. That’s why they are ALREADY voting with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot—but I need your support. ****
---
| [](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=aba5b216f6&e=84ee529f47)
---
We sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither on the vine in many places in our country.

But Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the world went mad.

We held the line when freedom hung in the balance.

We showed that we can — and must — revitalize America.

**I believe freedom is worth fighting for, and as your next President I promise I will never stop fighting for your freedom.** **[Will you fight alongside me?](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=da7114ab7d&e=84ee529f47 "Will you fight alongside me?")**

---
And we can win.

I'll make sure we have an economy that works for working families, a secure border that works for our nation, and so much more. The battle won’t be easy and will require a lot of toil and sweat to get it all done. I’m excited to share my agenda for America with you over the course of this campaign.

**But here’s why I’m writing you today:[I want to ask you to become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first team tele-townhall.](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=816f7a548f&e=84ee529f47 "I want to ask you to become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first Team Teletownhall.")**

I promise you, unlike other campaigns, our grassroots fundraising program is built on the principle that our donors are a part of our team, not our personal piggybank.

**_[I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=ce8ead0bb9&e=84ee529f47 "I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.")_**

Can I count on you?

Ron DeSantis

He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School. While at Harvard, he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

He was elected to Congress in 2012 and advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. Congressman DeSantis was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: Why I said yes to running for President
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
I wanted you to be one of the first people to know about this.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3rjrj73snnc5op74vulkgue4gojciqv14tsbg70_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs)
---
Friend,

It's official: I'M IN.

**I'm running for President of the United States. **
---
| | [JOIN ME](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zt5odt7jr6sb67dd6oerrv5ns3sqfdsn91o9g8to_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs)
---
Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots at Florida?

It's because he HATES what we're doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we're fighting back with freedom.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I can turn it around.

The American people know it, too. That's why they are ALREADY voting with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot--but I need your support. ** **
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zn68cot2srlm0tj3hoo8lsgpk6vu1r29qodanp1g_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs)
---
We sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither on the vine in many places in our country.

But Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the world went mad.

We held the line when freedom hung in the balance.

We showed that we can -- and must -- revitalize America.

**I believe freedom is worth fighting for, and as your next President I promise I will never stop fighting for your freedom.** **[Will you fight alongside me?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqbqfnttj0ooj7hegpss971099npg1gj62fu62jg_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs "Will you fight alongside me?")**
---
| | [YES, I'M READY TO WIN](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd0t6cq0udbkg0r2ukq349sbp97fp5igsrg7122o_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs)
---
And we can win, Friend.

I'll make sure we have an economy that works for working families, a secure border that works for our nation, and so much more. The battle won't be easy and will require a lot of toil and sweat to get it all done. I'm excited to share my agenda for America with you over the course of this campaign.

**But here 's why I'm writing you today, Friend: [I want to ask you to become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first team tele-townhall.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z64p5bh5medr78rp6vouhhuau7e1p58ta2b5ssko_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs "I want to ask you to become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first Team Teletownhall.")**

I promise you, unlike other campaigns, our grassroots fundraising program is built on the principle that our donors are a part of our team, not our personal piggybank.

**_[I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4ibc65or2933qs9k2ap9ls41e36eopd8uoskhco_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs "I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.")_**

Can I count on you?
---
| | [DONATE NOW](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3i40doj3e98omsi58bi3h6ft6h4gveaht3kokv8_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs)
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z58npdiu6n1gpac9hs1o0m019l4liaguibo9g7hg_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs)
---
In Freedom,

Ron DeSantis
---
_P.S I want to show you my appreciation for standing with me from Day 1 of this campaign. It 's why my team prepared gifts to thank our Day 1 donors.

If you chip in $47 by midnight on 5/25, we'll send you a limited-edition Day 1 membership card and an invite to our first-ever team tele-townhall.

Make sure you get yours now at this secure link: **[https://dsnts.com/aexHpu](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfm23bp17k8lpeo043obmo26sjsspdt1fm9mbkdo_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs)**_
---
|

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf7sfg032rodo33pa9ujirlbim8530t5shdjbdb0_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62o32c9h2bs)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he graduated with honors and was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School. While at Harvard, he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a federal prosecutor, where he targeted and convicted child predators. He was elected to Congress in 2012 and advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory. Congressman DeSantis was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award winning television host. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

##### EGRIU FOR ELLICOTT
## [Revitalizing Buffalo's East Side: Egriu for Ellicott's Journey from Neglect to Triumph](https://agewpw.clicks.mlsend2.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjg2ODgxLFwibFwiOjg5MTQ5OTU4NDMzODAxMjgwLFwiclwiOjg5MTQ5OTU5NTY3MzEyMzQ0fSIsInMiOiI0OTdjMzRiZWMwNDc2NWFhIn0)
Buffalo, NY – Today, community leaders issued a powerful call to action, aiming to transform the neglected East side of Buffalo into a triumphant symbol of progress. Focusing on the Jefferson Ave. corridor, this initiative seeks to create a brighter future for the children of Buffalo.
"Our collective conscience demands that we rise above complacency and deliver the better future our children deserve," stated a spokesperson for the initiative. "We cannot be prisoners of the past but rather pioneers of progress. The winds of change must gust forth from city hall." At the core of this transformation plan lies the revival of Jefferson Ave., marking the initial step towards revitalizing the district. The comprehensive strategy includes the resurrection of Homestead Park and the reestablishment of essential infrastructure to foster success for businesses of all sizes. "Investing in our businesses is crucial to their success," emphasized the spokesperson. "They deserve the necessary resources to thrive, from proper lighting to well-maintained sidewalks. City-owned lots and efficient snowplowing are essential in creating an environment that breeds success." The initiative also tackles the issue of crime, firmly stating that it is time to eradicate the shadows of criminal activity and elevate the quality of life for all residents. The plan proposes bold endeavors that showcase the community's unwavering commitment to building a future that aligns with the aspirations of our children. "The time for action is now," urged the spokesperson. "Together, we can shape a future that transcends mediocrity, where our children's dreams become realities. Let us empower our communities and pave the path to progress in Buffalo." This transformative initiative is driven by a strong desire to create a brighter future for the children of Buffalo, prioritizing their quality of life above all else. Through a resounding call to action, community leaders aspire to empower the community and establish the East side of Buffalo as a thriving district. For media inquiries or more information about the initiative, please contact: [Your Name] [Your Position] [Email Address] [Phone Number] About Egriu for Ellicott: Egriu for Ellicott is a community-driven initiative focused on bringing positive change to Buffalo, particularly the East side and the Jefferson Ave. corridor. Through strategic investments, revitalization efforts, and a commitment to community empowerment, Egriu for Ellicott aims to pave the path to progress and create a future where every child's dreams can become a reality.

body:

Pro-Life Statement

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology,
treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects.
Abortion that was once thought of

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWNKG-JDGN

From the
Desk of Dr. Ben Carson:
Hello,
I feel
like our culture has forgotten-or ignored-some very important and
basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.
Our
society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its
most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was
once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has
become the new normal.
Medicine
tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also
tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves,
and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not
treated as though they are alive or even human.
As a
surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you
that they are very much alive.

Dr. Ben
Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute
Life is a
precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No
person is disposable, and every life is precious according to
Him.
I believe
that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this
right by our society. I believe that together we can make a
difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also
believe that I'm not alone in this belief.
I believe
that you believe that too.
I've
started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are
looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that
values life but that takes people like you and I making a
commitment.
The first
step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing
to do to protect the lives of the unborn. Will you join me today
and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?
I've
created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you
read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals
and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the
unborn?

Dr. Ben

name: Colin Allred
subject: Inside Elections just downgraded Ted Cruz's chances
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
Peter, a lot of folks told me not to run against Ted Cruz.

They said a Democrat can't win a statewide election in Texas and that I
should stick with my "safe" seat in the House after winning with 66% of
the vote last year. But I'm not one to play it safe when our rights and
values are in danger.

And listen, this team raised more in the first 24 hours of our campaign
than Cruz did in the entire first quarter of 2023 – and the experts are
taking notice.

Already, the Cook Political Report upgraded our chances of winning, and
both Roll Call AND Inside Elections officially moved Texas from "Solid
Republican" to "Battleground"!

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18966?t=1001&akid=3268%2E346206%2E4PKAUi ]Peter, all of these experts are putting Ted Cruz on notice
because of the early strength of our grassroots campaign – but you know
that GOP donors are taking notice, too. So please, will you chip in a
split donation between my campaign and Charles Booker before my critical
end-of-month deadline to help fight back against the GOP, beat Ted Cruz
and flip Texas blue? I need to raise $100,000 today →

I've never felt better about our chances. Nate Silver's FiveThirtyEight
says Texas may be Democrats' best pickup opportunity next year, CNN is
calling Cruz one of the most vulnerable incumbents on the ballot and, if
we win in Texas, Democrats will hold the Senate Majority.

But CBS News says this could be one of the most expensive races in the
country, and with Senate control hanging in the balance, national
Republicans are pouring money into Cruz's war chest. They've already
launched their first attacks, and if we miss our fundraising goals, I
won't have the resources to fight back.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18966?t=1002&akid=3268%2E346206%2E4PKAUi ]That's why I'm personally asking: Will you split a donation of $30 or
more between my campaign and Charles Booker? Every dollar helps as we work
to defeat Ted Cruz, flip Texas blue and protect our Democratic Senate
majority →

Let's do this.

Colin Allred

subject: The answer to the question everyone has been asking me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
I wanted you to be one of the first people to know about this.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zirrl62rfigsqlgp1amddg3p2eu52rn8eg0rbjb8_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62p76cph2bs)
---
Friend,

It's official: I'M IN.

**I'm running for President of the United States. **
---
| | [JOIN ME](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztpql8nut1cabcal6ngf5iglnfq4fp4ea06fvr0o_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62p76cph2bs)
---
Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots at Florida?

It’s because he HATES what we’re doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we’re fighting back with freedom.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I can turn it around.

The American people know it, too. That’s why they are ALREADY voting with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot--but I need your support. ** **
---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z37j69d5co01jbjh3e4sjqv6e09sqfosvfvugiv0_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j62p76cph2bs)
---
We sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither on the vine in many places in our country.

But Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the world went mad.

We held the line when freedom hung in the balance.

We showed that we can -- and must -- revitalize America.

name: Bob Casey
subject: Today is a special day
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=82%2E552475%2E9_rzLF)
Peter, my team can tell you this, but I enjoy history. Particularly the history of our Commonwealth — and today is a special day in our nation and our Commonwealth’s history.
On this day in 1787, delegates from the states began to convene in Philadelphia to discuss and compose a new constitution for the United States. The constitutional convention would go on to include George Washington, James Madison, and PA’s own Benjamin Franklin — and what transpired was one of the most significant events in our history.
The convention brought together leaders who had differing opinions of how our government should work, but they emerged with one of the greatest and most enduring constitutions in the history of the world.
And Peter, the work to define our democracy that began on May 25th, 1787 has never stopped. We have spent more than two centuries striving toward the ideals of liberty, justice, and equality set forth in the Constitution, and amending it to ensure rights and freedoms for all Americans.
**Some moments in our recent history have reminded us that the fight for our democracy and to ensure those same rights still continues today.**
We have seen Republican extremists try to undermine the integrity of our elections by suggesting the 2020 presidential election was stolen, and they have attacked the right to vote across the country.
The fight for a free and fair democracy does not just belong to our history books. It is a fight that is still happening today, right here in Pennsylvania — the birthplace of American independence — where we’re battling to hold this seat and stop Republicans from gaining a Senate majority.
**[With your help, we can defend this seat and our Senate majority. Our end-of-month deadline is approaching fast, so I’d be grateful if you can pitch in any amount of support today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230525-1?refcode=em20230525-1&refcode2=82_552475_9_rzLF&akid=82%2E552475%2E9_rzLF)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230525-1?amount=5&refcode=em20230525-1&refcode2=82_552475_9_rzLF&akid=82%2E552475%2E9_rzLF)**
In addition to reflecting on how far we’ve come since the anniversary of the first day of our nation’s constitutional convention, I hope you will join me in the fight ahead.
With gratitude,
Bob Casey

name: Ron DeSantis for President
subject: Yes: I’m running for president, and this is why
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
Let’s put the rumors to rest once and for all.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z67bj55trdhhddj0elqtn1hfofa0jh7oa5auv8tg_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs)
---
Friend,

It's official: I'M IN.

**I'm running for President of the United States. **
---
| | [JOIN ME](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z8sjrra3htdapv0al70g3a80hr0ckp3hv9j0l1tg_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs)
---
Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots at Florida?

It's because he HATES what we're doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we're fighting back with freedom.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I can turn it around.

The American people know it, too. That's why they are ALREADY voting with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot--but I need your support. ** **
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zm4mv4c4mr4b1fnhigpfbqha9533dn7t49knolag_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs)
---
We sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither on the vine in many places in our country.

But Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the world went mad.

We held the line when freedom hung in the balance.

We showed that we can -- and must -- revitalize America.

**I believe freedom is worth fighting for, and as your next President I promise I will never stop fighting for your freedom.** **[Will you fight alongside me?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrf5gmbui4eig6g7dqjs1m70pr9kjqj8lofl1lbg_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs "Will you fight alongside me?")**
---
| | [YES, I'M READY TO WIN](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zk3g2lrmqmaucvld2deald32f7un0mud5n52e090_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs)
---
And we can win, Friend.

I'll make sure we have an economy that works for working families, a secure border that works for our nation, and so much more. The battle won't be easy and will require a lot of toil and sweat to get it all done. I'm excited to share my agenda for America with you over the course of this campaign.

**But here 's why I'm writing you today, Friend: [I want to ask you to become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first team tele-townhall.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zp7v5gv7tfj2fh9h6vdrgm8su8o2svb8soa3nsag_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs "I want to ask you to become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first Team Teletownhall.")**

I promise you, unlike other campaigns, our grassroots fundraising program is built on the principle that our donors are a part of our team, not our personal piggybank.

**_[I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfblq8hd5na8k2021h1s3vsrcsj9f9bkp7spo508_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs "I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.")_**

Can I count on you?
---
| | [DONATE NOW](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2za0q7r1nrl6nlc30host5qjk9a0k0mat41agkmog_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs)
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zuqoagb89iq05vbebeuqhcc4nurbprp35pdaboh0_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs)
---
In Freedom,

Ron DeSantis
---
_P.S I want to show you my appreciation for standing with me from Day 1 of this campaign. It 's why my team prepared gifts to thank our Day 1 donors.

If you chip in $47 by midnight on 5/25, we'll send you a limited-edition Day 1 membership card and an invite to our first-ever team tele-townhall.

Make sure you get yours now at this secure link: **[https://dsnts.com/aexHpu](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zh8ph8cc2dj073m5geohjmu484rs67fv7v27p2jg_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs)**_
---
|

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z795vi88fhct696jgangtdps5q5bmp758pmgs8h8_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j61pb2cjh2bs)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he graduated with honors and was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School. While at Harvard, he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a federal prosecutor, where he targeted and convicted child predators. He was elected to Congress in 2012 and advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory. Congressman DeSantis was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award winning television host. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

subject: Here’s How I Defeat Joe Biden
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
I wanted you to be one of the first people to know about this.
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._7BuUjQZSks3KEtqi9Q)
---
Peter,

It's official: I'M IN.

**I'm running for President of the United States. **
---
| | [JOIN ME](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-9qIvtx0SRFg6tn5jwA7lA)
---
Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots at Florida?

It’s because he HATES what we’re doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we’re fighting back with freedom.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I can turn it around.

The American people know it, too. That’s why they are ALREADY voting with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot—but I need your support. ** **
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
We sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither on the vine in many places in our country.

But Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the world went mad.

We held the line when freedom hung in the balance.

We showed that we can — and must — revitalize America.

**I believe freedom is worth fighting for, and as your next President I promise I will never stop fighting for your freedom.** **[Will you fight alongside me?](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-YzqNX0v1w1ijhoNWqC-KQ "Will you fight alongside me?")**
---
| | [YES, I’M READY TO WIN](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._LFfMdvXelA)
---
And we can win, Peter.

I'll make sure we have an economy that works for working families, a secure border that works for our nation, and so much more. The battle won’t be easy and will require a lot of toil and sweat to get it all done. I’m excited to share my agenda for America with you over the course of this campaign.

**But here’s why I’m writing you today, Peter:[I want to ask you to become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first team tele-townhall.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject. "I want to ask you to become a Launch Day Donor to my presidential campaign and join our first Team Teletownhall.")**

I promise you, unlike other campaigns, our grassroots fundraising program is built on the principle that our donors are a part of our team, not our personal piggybank.

**_[I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-ZK0FVwBw "I vow to treat you with respect: No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.")_**

Can I count on you?
---
| | [DONATE NOW](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._PaIha7tqeoIXqg)
---
In Freedom,

Ron DeSantis
---

If you chip in $47 by midnight on 5/25, we’ll send you a limited-edition Day 1 membership card and an invite to our first-ever team tele-townhall.

Make sure you get yours now at this secure link: **[https://dsnts.com/aexHpu](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._5bpjubGWX6lOx3etv3sw)**_

|

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-1XhtMxM1aWxw)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he graduated with honors and was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School. While at Harvard, he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a federal prosecutor, where he targeted and convicted child predators. He was elected to Congress in 2012 and advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory. Congressman DeSantis was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award winning television host. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.
