name: David Horowitz
subject: Investigate Joe Biden NOW
body:
Joe Biden may be coming after you next...

| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative, Joe Biden may be coming after you next... He’s weaponized the federal government to attack his political enemies and I need your help to stop him. [**That’s****why I’m asking you to sign the SELECT COMMITTEE TO INVESTIGATE BIDEN’S ABUSES OF POWER Petition right now.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0vrartvn2gr7edtefkc64d5lr343sg8ns1ujlg8_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j69or0cjh2bs) Just look at what’s happened in the past few months:
---
* Biden’s FBI used the Counterterrorism Division to conduct investigations into innocent parents protesting at school board meetings.
* Biden’s IRS is continuing to target and attack conservatives while allowing liberal groups like BLM to break the law.
* Biden’s Attorney General “personally approved” the unprecedented raid on President Trump’s home. And now he’s been indicted and arrested on bogus charges in New York City.
* Biden’s full-armed SWAT units are being used to arrest peaceful pro-life supporters.

---
These kinds of abuses of power are usually only seen in third-world dictatorships... But this is an organized effort across the government to intimidate Biden’s political opponents and silence anyone who disagrees with them. And we have to stop it. [**That’s why I’m asking you to sign the SELECT COMMITTEE TO INVESTIGATE BIDEN’S ABUSES OF POWER Petition.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z33hp50hie7pk7m8vnt0rpe5snu9nt0e6ddgv4no_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j69or0cjh2bs) Biden has declared war on America’s conservatives. He’s taken neutral law enforcement organizations and turned them into weapons of partisan politics. Only in Biden’s America can people who burn down police stations, attack courthouses and destroy statues walk free... ... While elderly pro-life activists are surrounded and arrested by dozens of fully-armed FBI agents. It’s insanity. I never thought I’d see something like that here in America... But this is where we are. Biden is weaponizing the government and if we don’t fight back NOW, it’s only going to get worse – [**so****please follow this link to sign the Petition right now.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zuu86vfkeua31lq4erniqe0numco32co4ga2ucs0_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j69or0cjh2bs) My friend, the Left will not stop. If they can’t win debating the message – they destroy the messenger. So, they attack. And attack. And attack. We must force Biden to answer for his crimes -- and a House Select Committee investigation is the best way for his abuses to see the light of day and hold him accountable. [**So****please sign the SELECT COMMITTEE TO INVESTIGATE BIDEN’S ABUSES OF POWER Petition right now.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z25adrna10ii717jci5bqgkret5btjcbt2h278l8_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j69or0cjh2bs) There isn’t a better group than the Freedom Center to lead this fight. You see, I was a leader in the radical Left movement in the 1960’s and 1970’s. I know their playbook – because I helped write it. Now I’m working to expose the TRUTH about the radical Left to a new generation that is being fooled. At the Freedom Center we use the Left’s tactics against them – we fight fire with fire – and we win. And because of our success, they hate us. Like President Trump, we’ve faced countless attacks from the Left:
---
* They got MasterCard to shut off our online fundraising and credit card processing (we got it turned back on).
* We had to find a new bank after the local bank we’ve been at for years suddenly closed our accounts.
* The hotel we’ve held our annual fundraising conference at for the last 20 years abruptly decided not to renew our contract.

---
No other group has faced these kinds of attacks because the radical Left fears us and our work. You see, we NEVER back down and we hit them where it hurts... but to stop Biden’s abuses of power I need your help. That’s why I’m asking you to do two things for me. [**The****first is to sign the SELECT COMMITTEE TO INVESTIGATE BIDEN’S ABUSES OF POWER Petition.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zn2d28j6vf62a0jsc47e6um5grbvbnri6mgarn78_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j69or0cjh2bs) Your name will be sent along with one million others and sent to Republican Caucus leader Kevin McCarthy demanding he creates a Select Committee to Investigate Biden’s abuses of power. [**The****second favor I’m asking of you today is to make an urgent one-time donation of $23 with your signed Petition.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zn1fp743i6kkdljin2ik7hicvftdqgo478na1gkg_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j69or0cjh2bs) Your $23 one-time donation will be used to send an additional 44 **SELECT COMMITTEE TO INVESTIGATE BIDEN’S ABUSES OF POWER** Petitions to like-minded patriots across the country. The only way we’re going to stop Joe Biden is with an overwhelming campaign across America. That’s why your $23 donation is so critical. We must bring more people to our cause and get them to join our fight. And I’m sorry, but we cannot wait or delay -- we must act now. [**That’s****why if you’re blessed enough to make a larger donation of $35, $50, $100 or more I would be eternally grateful.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za394gcqn4p1ok47csbid3rost0a1idqb7c81tk0_rp22sh2s8i66o75c1j69or0cjh2bs) Just know that your one-time donation of $23, $50, $100 or more will be put to immediate use stopping Joe Biden’s abuses of power, because nothing is more important... If they can go after a former President and a peaceful pro-life father who have done nothing wrong – you could be next, so please rush back your signed Petition right away.

name: Helen Gym
subject: Thank you for a historic run
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Helen Gym
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hhg-april23-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hhg-april23-em]
This is not a request for money. It’s a message about what’s at stake in today’s election.
Please forward this email to every Philadelphia voter you know.

For too many Philadelphians, the status quo is simply not working.

Too many families suffer the horror of gun violence. Too many children go to school in crumbling buildings overrun by lead, asbestos, and mold. Too many workers are underpaid, disrespected, and unable to support their families. And too many people have lost faith in our system to fix any of it.

Everything must change. I’m asking for your vote today as the only candidate who’ll fight to truly transform our city — not tinker around the edges.

From day one of this race, our opponents, their wealthy supporters, and the political establishment have called our plans too big. But the truth is their ideas are too small.

With grassroots communities at my side, I’ve spent 30 years taking on fights others said were unwinnable, and folks, we’ve done a lot of winning: restoring nurses and counselors to public schools, keeping thousands of renters in their homes, guaranteeing predictable schedules for hourly workers, taking control of our school system back from the state, and so much more.

Today, I’m asking for your vote so we can continue building power and fighting for a better Philadelphia — together.

Together, we’ll finally secure adequate funding for the libraries, rec centers, parks, and green spaces that keep our kids safe, and we’ll transform where our children learn with a Green New Deal for public schools.

Together, we’ll ensure every Philadelphian is safe and feels safe — not only by responding more effectively to crime, but by investing to address the root causes of it. We’ll keep people in their homes, guarantee employment for our youth, and provide mental health support to those who need it.

And together, we’ll build an economy that works for all of us. We’ll support the union way of life, stop corporate landlords from exacerbating our housing crisis, and deliver a municipal Green New Deal that creates good-paying local jobs and combats the climate crisis.

We get the city we fight for — so I’m fighting for a city worth living in. This is our moment to build a Philadelphia where public schools are strong, communities are safe, workers are protected, and young people have a future to believe in.

I would be incredibly honored if you cast your ballot for me today, and forward this email to three friends who may do the same. If everyone reading this email does that, I promise you we will win.

Tonight is not the end of this fight; it’s the start of another chapter, a new beginning full of promise and potential. Let’s make it happen together.

— Helen
Helen Gym is a Philly mom, a school teacher, a community organizer, and former City Councilmember. She has been fighting for Philly families and communities for decades — winning more resources for our schools, safer communities, and a more affordable Philadelphia. Our efforts are supported by everyday people like you who give what they can, whenever they can, because they want to see a safer, more prosperous, equitable Philadelphia that works for all of us. Marcy Kaptur

Team,
In the middle of the night last month, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis signed a 6-week abortion ban, affecting as many as 4 million Florida women.
Since then, Republican majorities have passed bans in Nebraska, North Carolina, and North Dakota. In total, abortions are banned in twenty different states.
These policies are not based on any sort of science or research. They are, however, another calculated attack on reproductive rights.
Leaders pushing their far-right, radical agenda have been working to dismantle reproductive rights for decades. They’ve had some big victories in the last year, with the Supreme Court handing them their biggest with the _Dobbs_ decision.
That's why restoring and protecting reproductive rights nationwide is one of my top priorities in the Senate.
Here are four bills I’m fighting for right now:
1. The _Women’s Health and Protection Act_ (WHPA) would finally codify abortion rights into federal law, guarantee equal access to abortion across the nation, and protect against any future challenges of our reproductive rights;
2. The _Let Doctors Provide Reproductive Health Care Act_ would protect doctors and providers in states where abortion remains legal from prosecution for providing abortions;
3. The _SAFER Health Act_ would strengthen privacy protections to prohibit providers from disclosing information related to abortion or pregnancy loss;
4. The _Equal Access to Abortion Coverage in Health Insurance_ (EACH) Act would guarantee abortion coverage for those who rely on Medicaid and other federal health plans.

While Colorado is a safe haven for women seeking reproductive care, women across the country are already facing the consequences of a post-Roe world. And, now, my Republican colleagues have made it clear that they want a federal law to ban abortion nationwide — including right here in Colorado.
[**Will you add your name today and join me in calling on Congress to pass these bills into law? State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

DeSantis signed an extreme anti-immigrant bill attacking our freedom to move with dignity — including making it a crime to drive into Florida with someone who is undocumented, invalidating out-of-state driver’s licenses for undocumented people, and infringing on people’s right to work by enforcing the flawed E-Verify system.
**No matter which far-right candidate wins the Republican nomination, they will pose a threat to immigrant communities.**
It can be demoralizing to see politicians build their brand by trying to divide us. **But we cannot look away — and the work to keep them far away from higher office starts now.**
In last year’s midterm elections, we contacted more than 2 million Latinx, young, and infrequent voters to ensure they made their voices heard. We’ll need to multiply our civic engagement work before 2024 if we want to keep harmful candidates like DeSantis out of the White House.
**Donate now to help us fight back against anti-immigrant candidates and policies. With your help, we’ll keep making progress to make sure that everyone, regardless of immigration status, can live free and thrive.**

| Peter, **I'll be LIVE SOON at 4:30PM EDT for my Common Ground Podcast, and I have some incredible New Jersyans, including dedicated local business owners, joining me.** Today will be about taking care of business and businesses in New Jersey. Local businesses are the backbone of our community, driving economic growth, creating jobs, and fostering a sense of pride and unity among residents. They represent the dreams, aspirations, and hard work of our friends and neighbors, striving to build a better future for themselves and their families. Now, more than ever, they need our unwavering support.

---
| | [CLICK HERE TO OPEN THE COMMON GROUND STREAM NOW (I'LL BE LIVE AT 4:30PM EDT)](https://xtz223.keap-link007.com/v2/click/0a205908949c7c8948074695a99b32c1/eJyNj00LgkAURf_LW0t-R7iTEBk0F1HrMH3UkI7D-JRM_O-NFa4K2r537rncEQhFLoiVEMCdHo7jggEKCy45Cto2gvLi9XV8z3ZtAyoubrFqOgnB-DW8APPZtnzPABokauSwD7cJy-JTyrJEkzJXuuMvz2ZtLZpoF7IUpumnF2tOUa_VLQSkOpwHlVyPoqOqNH8lkm1gmkVT14246A5RroqqO5sV71ELcilRlJ_xCQ5vzfQEyH5irA==)
---
|

| One issue that is plaguing New Jersey businesses right now stems from the governor hoping to eliminate the current liquor license system, which will open up licenses with no limitations and ban the private sale of licenses. For the 7,000+ pubs, taverns, bars, and family-owned restaurants that have a current license estimated to be valued between $300,000 and $1 million, this would be a crushing blow to the value of their business. Diane Weiss of NJ Beverage Liquor Association, John Ellery of Ellery’s Pub & Grill and Tom Jannone of Ocean View Restaurant and Bar, all of whom oppose the ridiculous notion of unlimited liquor licenses in New Jersey, will be joining me to shed light on how important it is to local businesses for us to come together and fight back. My final special guest for the day, Rob Gill, is the Founder and CEO of EPIC Financial Strategies. He and his team have performed more than 23,000 cash flow analyses and over 10,000 financial plans. Their mission is to provide financial education to a world that desperately needs more of it. Rob will be coming on to talk business and financial empowerment. Make sure you [**join us now (we'll be live right at 4:30PM EDT),**](https://xtz223.keap-link007.com/v2/click/369002bd5583c01d73dce7d8f367ffd6/eJyNj00LgkAURf_LW0t-ZYQ7EZFBcxG1DtNHDek4jE_JxP_eWOGqoO17557LHYFQ5IJYCT7c6eE4LhigsOCSo6CwEZQXr6_jrW3XNqDi4harppPgj1_DCzCfbctzDKBBokYO-yBMWBafUpYlmpS50h1_ebYba9FEu4ClME0_vVhzinqtbsEn1eE8qOR6FB1VpfkrkWx90yyaum7ERXeIclVU3dmseI9akEuJovyMT3B4a6Ynxupiqg==) Bill

clean_body: | = Peter, = When I think about why I'm running for Congress, I think about my kids -- specifically my daughter, Maya. = I'll never forget the day six years ago when Maya came home from kindergarten and told me about some “exercises” she’d done with her classmates. She didn't quite understand what was going on, but I realized she was describing an active shooter drill. It hit me at that moment; we now live in a country where millions of Americans fear that a hug goodbye before school, a concert, or even church, could be the last. I also think about the Supreme Court's ruling on Roe v. Wade. Right now, Maya is on a path to have less control over her body than my wife, or even my mom, did. I never imagined that was possible, and it's completely unacceptable. The problem we face is that a major political party in our country is not willing to take common sense steps to save lives. The good news is we have the power to change that; if we can change who represents us in Congress. My Republican opponent Mike Garcia co-sponsored a bill that would create a nationwide ban on abortion without exceptions. Literally days after the mass shooting in Uvalde, Texas, Garcia was taking cash from a pro-gun group that opposes background checks. My campaign to unseat Mike Garcia is one of the most important races in taking Congress back from extremists. | | **This week we commemorated the collapse of the Skagit River Bridge.** On the evening of May 23, 2013 a large truck traveling south on I-5 clipped the frame of the bridge and caused a span of the bridge to collapse into the river. We were blessed that no one died or was injured in the collapse of the bridge. But in a heartbreaking accident eight days later, a Washington State Patrol Trooper, Sean O'Connell Jr., was killed while directing traffic in the aftermath of the bridge collapse. **The collapse of the Skagit River Bridge and the accident that took the life of Trooper O'Connell remind us how important infrastructure investment is to the safety and prosperity of our communities.** Bridges should not collapse. Our officers should not be needlessly in harm's way. **Our communities should not suffer like this. That is why I work so hard to ensure we invest in the infrastructure of our communities.** Whether that is the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law I helped pass, my work with local leaders and tax payers to improve our infrastructure, or my daily work as ranking member of the Infrastructure Committee; **I am committed to improving our infrastructure and keeping our communities safe.** The strength of our community and our grassroots involvement are the reasons I can do the hard work of legislating in Congress. subject: Your Supreme Court survey
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs4uWHJDNY

Hillsdale College

Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey
on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os4uWHJDNY

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend,

Your participation in Hillsdale
College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is
requested.

Your response will only take a few
minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and
the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the
proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court
differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put
it in a Boston Globe op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to
a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you
today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme
Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me
using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme
Court right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form
effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the proper
role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution
instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your National
Survey on the United States Supreme Court using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61844964:s4uWHJDNY:m:3:2532013465:0A06FD26882BC16FC22C82B98134D6A8:r

Thank you for your time and
attention-and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty
since 1844

Hillsdale College 33 East College St Hillsdale, MI
49242 USA

Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots at Florida?

It's because he HATES what we're doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we're fighting back with freedom.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I can turn it around.

The American people know it, too. That's why they are ALREADY voting with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot--but I need your support. ** **
---
| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=bc1beacf06694550a9c4ae09a05ecf13&_e=ohX4HBJFhVg1BTsdrlM5tUS96mClfC9FWBmhxvfwDanu00DagRUEI94RnKAwTiOp8oSszuWZ2r0gmci9kECN_f9sRkP5XIfa6j-90xkIhyQGbCLWI0_2DusBpjFTXd7fsF8TodJqVTMD0Yfy8qRS2rYclbWOKSoWdQ--eVoXJDiqaE9WVl_4aaRyxorFH9eAVbxCH8CV9z-gp_f6o0ZkPOBJBVivBUYO2sdbvo2NyXeJCl5XP22tF7caYJB1CLIKYjM6GkiO9rSBkqYM5dKytSw4Uj49iDvGrXff9iZxYyXursYsLzaw2xBkMOfg1tjM02UIrH8PAJ8G6MPoGoIJ2wQETOevsjDqHdsEDIYsqKF2u0OaflfgXQsjMEGWoRCXBJPugTk1eTckrKE8_8lrwK94g4y8dEMNxfLwlsbmAb4%3D)

We sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither on the vine in many places in our country.

But Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the world went mad.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a federal prosecutor, where he targeted and convicted child predators. He was elected to Congress in 2012 and advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory. Congressman DeSantis was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award winning television host. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Today Fox News broke a story from the Media Research Center about the Department of Homeland Security targeting conservative, Christian, and Republican groups, and labeling them as potential terrorist organizations. Below is my official statement, and you can watch me discuss these shocking revelations tonight on Eric Bolling The Balance on Newsmax at 8pm ET.
---
**Tea Party Patriots Action Slams DHS for Funding Anti-Terrorism Program Linking Tea Party to Nazis** Atlanta, GA – Today, FoxNews.com reported that Department of Homeland Security (DHS) doled out taxpayer money through an anti-terrorism grant initiative to a University of Dayton program that explicitly lumped the Tea Party and conservative groups into the same category as Nazis (link to story). Tea Party Patriots Action (TPPA) Honorary Chairman Jenny Beth Martin issued the following statement: "The Biden administration’s weaponization of government continues. Tea Party Patriots Action is a grassroots conservative organization with about three million members and supporters. We peacefully mobilize our members to advocate conservative values. To have DHS funds be in an anti-terrorism program that links us to Nazis and puts us on a ‘pyramid of far-right radicalization’ is offensive and disgraceful.
“TPPA has already suffered from government abuse of power. During the Obama era, Tea Party Patriots was deliberately targeted and persecuted by the IRS in one of the biggest government scandals of the modern era.
“Prior to today’s revelations, we had called for Secretary Mayorkas to be impeached because of his willful refusal to enforce our immigration laws, causing the historic crisis on our southern border. Today, we are once again demanding that Secretary Mayorkas be impeached and for DHS to return to its original mission of protecting our country, instead of trying to intimidate conservative Americans.”

Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots at Florida?

It's because he HATES what we're doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we're fighting back with freedom.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I can turn it around.

The American people know it, too. That's why they are ALREADY voting with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot--but I need your support. ** **

We sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither on the vine in many places in our country.

But Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the world went mad.

We held the line when freedom hung in the balance.

We showed that we can -- and must -- revitalize America.

**I believe freedom is worth fighting for, and as your next President I promise I will never stop fighting for your freedom.** **[Will you fight alongside me?](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=73b6e786ceea4321a5f66f42b37a15f8&_e=Zh3PbngCBUjanIHpXCVSs1A6pFklou7i2kxupNLuP1IgrP8NwHsWw-2Y8zP_rKxH7r78tOyqo2fBBKieYX80OtAy6kuWuOVaukBLlvBQegzNA8axqiiSXa8HbBK2ay27d6lXBIMpunMuQjBzxpwg5XgW0fl2mXUBb9bPktzmjtuFEsI5bwMGDEqKcC7Skug1kzRxywowVv_XAgp0ET4Kx31H_e6sLCxwf_cV_lTQMHfhk6kVMx3bVzHIMMfVYGsb8FS1RT4IBGt6XCj9VZTAjY75ZE35n95Qu9mwZtHbi6AwZ5t1_VZrzl25-plKYDAPHiS1ZcVerJF5DHCCChL2MOD7ry9GggzpEYG9LCg6yg0k8NIlcnjOMHAG8Z8G2LJ5_IcBQ400ILj5bF_0KiwgTvzgNJw2YBVeQTKurwfC9teflN0thkm_JVT46vcJmGIk "Will you fight alongside me?")**

body:
Friend, a lot of folks told me not to run against Ted Cruz.
They said a Democrat can't win a statewide election in Texas and that I should stick with my "safe" seat in the House after winning with 66% of the vote last year. But I'm not one to play it safe when our rights and values are in danger.
And listen, this team raised more in the first 24 hours of our campaign than Cruz did in the entire first quarter of 2023 – and the experts are taking notice.
Already, the Cook Political Report upgraded our chances of winning, and both Roll Call AND Inside Elections officially moved Texas from "Solid Republican" to "Battleground"!
Friend, all of these experts are putting Ted Cruz on notice because of the early strength of our grassroots campaign – but you know that GOP donors are taking notice, too. So please, will you chip in a split donation between my campaign and Southern Progress before my critical end-of-month deadline to help fight back against the GOP, beat Ted Cruz and flip Texas blue? I need to raise $100,000 today → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
I've never felt better about our chances. Nate Silver's FiveThirtyEight says Texas may be Democrats' best pickup opportunity next year, CNN is calling Cruz one of the most vulnerable incumbents on the ballot and, if we win in Texas, Democrats will hold the Senate Majority.
But CBS News says this could be one of the most expensive races in the country, and with Senate control hanging in the balance, national Republicans are pouring money into Cruz's war chest. They've already launched their first attacks, and if we miss our fundraising goals, I won't have the resources to fight back.
That's why I'm personally asking: Will you split a donation of $15 or more between my campaign and Southern Progress? Every dollar helps as we work to defeat Ted Cruz, flip Texas blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
Let's do this.
Colin Allred

They said a Democrat can't win a statewide election in Texas and that I should stick with my "safe" seat in the House after winning with 66% of the vote last year. But I'm not one to play it safe when our rights and values are in danger. And listen, this team raised more in the first 24 hours of our campaign than Cruz did in the entire first quarter of 2023 – and the experts are taking notice. Already, the Cook Political Report upgraded our chances of winning, and both Roll Call AND Inside Elections officially moved Texas from "Solid Republican" to "Battleground"! Friend, all of these experts are putting Ted Cruz on notice because of the early strength of our grassroots campaign – but you know that GOP donors are taking notice, too. So please, will you chip in a split donation between my campaign and Southern Progress before my critical end-of-month deadline to help fight back against the GOP, beat Ted Cruz and flip Texas blue? Peter,
I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to you today because I believe in the power of our community and the **urgent** need for change.
My name is Caroline Kane. I’ve been a successful businesswoman in the Houston area for the past 25 years. I thought I’d be in the private sector forever, but, it’s time for me to switch gears.
I live in Texas and have watched what has gone on in our state and country for too long from the sidelines.
As a conservative, I’ve watched as my district is represented by a Democrat for the past four years and I’ve watched too often as Republicans run for office and barely put up a fight.
**This year, I decided I can’t sit on the sidelines anymore. I don’t see anyone fighting against these people the way they need to be fought against, so I decided to do it myself.**
Congress needs someone who will fight for what matters to YOU, one who is not afraid to disrupt the system, and one who will be a fresh-face and new perspective to Washington.

[**It’s time we send LIONS to Congress, to solve modern-day challenges and get America back on track. That’s where I come in.**](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=db91001855&e=84ee529f47)

---
Simply put, we need a Great Restoration to combat The Great Reset.
This is the most critical juncture that we’ve faced in generations.
The people that are currently running our nation are not incompetent, though it does seem that way. They are extremely efficient at giving us the worst possible outcomes.
They are actively trying to dismantle America and destroy what it means to be an American.
This is bigger than our two-party system. This is bigger than anything that we have ever seen before. We are engaged in a spiritual battle for the soul of our nation.
If we don’t act now, in these next eighteen months, the nation that we grew up in will no longer exist.
That is not hyperbole — it is fact. They want to make us subjects rather than citizens.
Too many among us are still not aware of the actual agenda that controls the people in power. Many believe the current situation is simply a phase that we will pass through.
**Well, they couldn’t be more wrong.**
We must work hard to remove these people from power and elect true patriotic Americans, there will be no country left to govern, only a collection of people required to adhere, obey, and pay tribute.
I’m running for Texas’s 7th Congressional District — a seat that will help determine control of Congress in 2024. This is one of the most expensive media markets in the country and I really need you to stand with me.
[**Can I count on a donation of $5.00 or more today?**](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=998dad3934&e=84ee529f47)

Every single day from now until the primary, I’m going to need to be reaching voters with my message.
Every single donation helps me get my name out to more people in the district so that we can actually WIN this race!
We need to restore this nation to its former glory, stand strong against the enemies who wish to ruin us and fight hard to save America.
We can’t rely on politicians and bureaucrats to get this done; this is going to be a movement led by the citizenry.
We live in the greatest country on earth. We cannot afford to lose it.
We, the people, must take our country back. This is our time.
Stand with me today and let’s win this district and save our nation!

## Reviews & Announcement
---
At [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12555.1.ca16f49b126a6c553740dd70919f598c) OKC & Tulsa, I have launched a new WKND series over the [Book of Acts](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12556.1.deccfffeb0cd122798841e2a72ee7656): verse by verse. So far, the response has been **AMAZING**. Over the last six weeks, I have addressed a wide range of topics from the first two chapters of Acts: [the Power of the Holy Spirit](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12557.1.0bf0204383c0fbb421fc25a65fa8bd2a), [the Miracle of Suffering](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12558.1.4bc5391377d22314e94be070b1e07513), [Casting Lots](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12559.1.dda25cf2efdcd35d2c628dca613cc2fd), [Pentecost](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12560.1.669bc3230a32f1f3f75cb445bcc72e05) & [Speaking in Tongues](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12561.1.0118350bdc9ac72e29f1ec62c883172e). I believe these messages will tremendously bless you and you are always welcome to one of our WKND services in OKC & Tulsa. Watch the Book Of Acts [here](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12562.1.9197ec9dc7930820ad4c29b7d4b41a03). _On another note_ , I am excited to announce that [Sheridan Bible College](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12563.1.f133c19bcac8ae1c354d734a43d8bde4) is transitioning from a one year program to a two year program starting in the Fall of 2023! **Fall 2023 Courses:**
-Eschatology
-Romans
-Life Of Christ
-Christian Leadership
-Genesis
-7 Feasts Of Israel **Spring 2024 Courses:**
-Hebrews & General Epistles
-5-Fold Ministry
-Early Church History
-Hermeneutics
-Johannine Literature
-Helps Ministry Each semester consists of six courses. The classes take place on Tuesday and Thursday evenings starting at 6 pm CT. If you would like to **dive deeper into the Word of God** then I want to encourage you to checkout Sheridan Bible College. If you are unable to make the classes in-person at [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12564.1.0e089a0b89e0103aadbf0c77b9928cc7) in Tulsa, OK that is not an issue. Each class will be streamed live online as well as uploaded for our online students. This means you can take the classes from ANYWHERE at ANYTIME. The pricing is **TOTALLY** affordable. Tuition is only $300 per semester (around $100/month). This is an investment that I guarantee will bring about a great return in your life. To learn more and to apply visit: [https://www.sheridan.church/biblecollege](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=22104883.12565.1.5d79e4b6988e55aab1f14f673d945a00) Thank you,

subject: Celebrating & Reflecting In May
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Dear Friends,

May is a month of celebration and reflection across our communities. We celebrate the AANHPI community and its vast contributions to our nation’s history, acknowledging the leaders that have pushed the community forward in the story of America.

We honor the storied history of Jewish Americans and their part in creating the nation we know today. Jewish Americans are instrumental in furthering the ideals that our country was founded on.

We also want to reflect on the violence that Indigenous communities have faced throughout history and even into the present day. We must work together in solidarity to ensure the safety of Indigenous people and seek justice for those wronged in the past.

As we reflect on this month, we know that we are so lucky to be doing all of this work with you. Thank you for all you have done - and let’s finish the job!
---
|
---
| **Happy AANHPI Heritage Month!**
---
|
---
| This is a time to celebrate the rich diversity of our Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander communities, and to highlight all of the magnificent contributions that the AANHPI community has made to our nation throughout history. For the DNC statement on AANHPI Heritage Month, [please click here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=35d3fcbc0e&e=d6c5c7d7ec). From Representative Dalip Singh Saund to Vice President Kamala Harris, we have seen AANHPI leaders at the forefront of our country for decades. So many have paved the way for us to celebrate our cultures, our identities, and our communities, and we hope to continue to do the same for those that come after us. The AANHPI community has been vital to the fabric of this nation for centuries, and we will continue to be for centuries to come.

To commemorate this important month, the DNC AAPI Caucus hosted _Key to the Future_ , A Heritage Month Celebration on Thursday, May 11th. Chair Jaime Harrison, Senator Tammy Duckworth, Lieutenant Governor Aruna Miller of Maryland, and a panel of five young AANHPI organizers and leaders were able to discuss the importance of the AANHPI community to the Democratic Party. So let us all take some time this month to reflect on the giants on whose shoulders we stand on, and to also continue to build the foundation for a more equitable society for all in the future.
---
|
---
| **DNC on Missing or Murdered Indigenous Persons Awareness Day**
May 5, 2023
---
|
---
For the DNC Statement of Missing or Murdered Indigenous Persons Awareness, Day, [please click here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=14ba6de668&e=d6c5c7d7ec).
| In honor of [Missing or Murdered Indigenous Persons (MMIP) Awareness Day](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=64e1d75681&e=d6c5c7d7ec), the DNC Native Caucus held an event last week to receive a special message from U.S. Senator Catherine Cortez Masto of Nevada and a briefing from the Montana Missing Indigenous Persons Task Force’s presiding officer, Councilwoman Ellie Bundy of the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes. The DNC Native Caucus Chair, Clara Pratte, also highlighted progress made under the Biden-Harris Administration, including the [2021 Executive Order 14053](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=21152c63b6&e=d6c5c7d7ec), the passage of the Violence Against Women Reauthorization Act of 2022, and the ongoing work of the Department of the Interior’s new Missing and Murdered Unit within the Bureau of Indian Affairs Office of Justice Services.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| [**Jewish American Heritage Month**](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=53284f4797&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
---
| “This May, we honor generations of Jewish Americans for their innumerable contributions to American history and culture. Jewish American Heritage Month is an opportunity to reflect on the traditions and contributions of Jewish Americans to our country, and celebrate the Jewish American leaders who have helped further our nation’s founding ideals of justice, equality, and freedom – even in the face of persecution and oppression. In fields from science to literature to public service, generations of Jewish Americans have made innumerable contributions to our country." For the full DNC statement, [please click here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=2bd1714833&e=d6c5c7d7ec).

Peter,

**I'm running for President of the United States. **

---
Have you ever noticed how often Joe Biden tries to take potshots at Florida?

It’s because he HATES what we’re doing in the Sunshine State.

While he pushes the woke agenda, we’re fighting back with freedom.

Joe Biden is taking the country in the wrong direction. But I know I can turn it around.

The American people know it, too. That’s why they are ALREADY voting with their feet. Our population is booming in the free state of Florida.

Now, I want to put that choice on the ballot—but I need your support. ** **
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._w)
---
We sometimes take freedom for granted. You should not do that after the last few years. It is contested, and we have seen it wither on the vine in many places in our country.

But Florida was different. We chose facts over fear. We chose education over indoctrination. We chose law and order over rioting and disorder. Florida was a refuge of sanity when the world went mad.

We held the line when freedom hung in the balance.

We showed that we can — and must — revitalize America.

**I believe freedom is worth fighting for, and as your next President I promise I will never stop fighting for your freedom.** **[Will you fight alongside me?](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.--GLg "Will you fight alongside me?")**

He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School. While at Harvard, he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Congressman DeSantis was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award winning television host. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

name: Becky Wagner
subject: My husband is facing 10 years in prison for defending himself
body:
Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.

Dear Friend,
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...
...but my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, is the next big target of the radical anti-police movement and I urgently need your help before they make an example out of him.
That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo.
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e3d4b89fc58546e2988d2fc89de04fd7&_e=dIdkaDxo8lPG3dz5i9c2w-NIGF0IRn7nMth0cAeGW583lFJON0a5XLTvV3OgazAs7x5IRtE8Gz-lWDJbZSOx2dyb7bY7CL4cEuHgg1lBbW8YOsaOgUtwSxtIgc2EwLBZEAb7nSFsuDmdU8MbLDCDCZF4KgWHx4zTLL_EQbHVq31UDfPn8sv3dfLjwO8i0ENEPT9UJZiZwjWSMis9pPEOBcqFjK-qOrz8lAQiiSXN13tSULFs_8KdZmiRdJRsGiLbszjtFF3O9F6IL_cl86obe15a9ReN2PFPaoA1z3IQkn7LaXO3JXdSOqCQGn0K_INP9pnhim2OJ7K6qM9B-0EfOgDMfMnh0nHYzNemXL5onQ4%3D)
Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.
He's dedicated his life to protecting others. But we live in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage, LIED about what happened, and trashed Mark's reputation.
And now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. [**That 's why I wrote this letter to you, someone I've never met before, to ask for your help.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e3d4b89fc58546e2988d2fc89de04fd7&_e=dIdkaDxo8lPG3dz5i9c2w-NIGF0IRn7nMth0cAeGW583lFJON0a5XLTvV3OgazAs7x5IRtE8Gz-lWDJbZSOx2dyb7bY7CL4cEuHgg1lBbW8YOsaOgUtwSxtIgc2EwLBZEAb7nSFsuDmdU8MbLDCDCZF4KgWHx4zTLL_EQbHVq31UDfPn8sv3dfLjwO8i0ENEsj0t7BWovhUxkZe0cYe9KAc6sc5tLvZ4G8nA2V1kS2gIKpWpiqfTu9RKhu3Ll5dnaMLanAw0UxRn7rrwhLqoatxui19NPiJ5u4glFRpXQvUB9HJN8o15HgrsKvJGijb29TTRMZrjAn4CBPcECuXJ0jWeF8fuQp6yDXQYDZreMec%3D)
But first, let me explain what happened...
On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a _violent_ _criminal_ named Quadren Wilson.
Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for allegedly dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom.
Mark's arrest team planned to capture Wilson in his vehicle using a containment strategy. They pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But Wilson floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape justice.

subject: Join me in supporting Governor DeSantis for President
body:
I am still so grateful for your support for my campaign... | | | |
---
| | | Dear Friends, I am still so grateful for your support for my campaign. Through my columns, radio appearances and work on school choice, energy independence and rebuilding our party, I am continuing the work that I’ve always been committed to. Our campaign was focused on our future—not only pointing out that things are turning upside-down; but, offering a path forward. Our nation needs to return to kitchen-table priorities, common-sense policies to address our true problems and support that values that have served our nation. I’m writing this note while in Miami, having been part of “day one” of Governor Ron DeSantis’ campaign for President. After much reflection, I have decided that the best candidate to leads us into the future for the Republican Party—and, more importantly, our nation—is Governor DeSantis. I am volunteering my time and donating to his campaign because he has a proven record of growing his state’s economy; focusing education on reading, writing, arithmetic and science; and, fighting-back against intrusive government mandates. And, having been elected by only 0.6% in 2018; he was re-election in Florida, with almost 60% of the vote—with strong support across the state and among all ethnicities. A growing, vibrant Republican Party. A focus on common-sense. And, a proven record of success. I’m asking you to join me in support Governor DeSantis’ campaign for President. Please consider making a donation; signing-up to volunteer; or joining his email list to receive updates that you can share with friends. Please use this personal link: investor.dsnts.com/1134 I’m not interested in criticizing any of the Republican candidates for President. Rather, my focus is on our future and my belief that Governor DeSantis is the best candidate to lead us forward. In the end, its my hope that Republicans will be united—and, welcome Independents and Democrats, who want to support a positive, hopeful future for our children and our nation. A strong nation, with a growing economy, energy independence and not beholden to our enemies. Thanks for your consideration. Please contact me of any questions. Together, we can work together to be part of the Great American Comeback. Sincerely yours, Guy Ciarrocchi @GuyCiarrocchi

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/63810981/408097731/1995090618?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1Njg5Y2ZjNS0zNGZiLWVkMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_rlQAcJjVOpGOLDBxyyWMP9DaGVz7pW67z8mBrqau2I=&emci=efdde8e3-6dfa-ed11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=5689cfc5-34fb-ed11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=4568237)

| | There’s a mental health crisis hurting our kids and teens, Derek. Our children are growing up in a toxic social media landscape, and it’s taking its toll. Experts have made it abundantly clear that social media platforms have evidence that their unregulated landscapes are exacerbating issues like bullying, eating disorders, and mental health struggles. Yet they still haven’t made any meaningful changes to mitigate these issues. subject: Saving Democracy: A User’s Manual for Every American
body:
It’s on all our minds
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T88d66b24-43bd-49ca-bc62-6fc9e0bdf3c0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **I’d like to share with you a message from my good friend David Pepper, former Chair of the Ohio Democratic Party. He's warned of autocracy on the march in our states for a few years now, and has a [new must-read book on the subject, “Saving Democracy”](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tce3ba0a4-3bde-41f4-b77b-01c61b354fd4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9):** Two years ago, as we were fixated on Washington—the opening months of the Biden Administration, January 6th and its aftermath—I was disturbed by what I saw in states across the country, starting with my home state, Ohio. A non-stop attack on democracy in long-ignored statehouses across the country, while so many focused elsewhere. It was the exact opposite of the famous quote by Justice Brandeis (that states were “laboratories of democracy”). I realized then I’d be writing **_Laboratories of _Autocracy**. I described in painful detail how it worked, and how we could best fight back. I released the book in September 2021, and have been honored by the response ever since. Yet, I heard a consistent refrain— “it was so painful, I had to skip to the end to learn what I could do.” [So, I decided to write a follow-up book that skips to the end, ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc4cdc2d1-a9dd-4169-892c-df543a17c348/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_[explaining to every American how they can (andmust) play a role in saving our democracy](https://default.salsalabs.org/T006de2d3-a43f-489b-9da2-3f2732f73772/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._ **I titled it _[Saving Democracy: A User’s Manual for Every American](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb1cb821e-e79d-4679-9713-c711dc9eff5b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). _Y _esterday, we officially LAUNCHED._** [I explain how we must reframe our political battle as a wider battle for democracy](https://default.salsalabs.org/T920c1c6c-9a72-49a8-bcab-1b0ccaff79eb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) at all levels and go on offense. [I walk through how every American can actively take part in the work I outline](https://default.salsalabs.org/T79539b63-fff1-4627-a2e8-163116cf0cda/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). I use case studies, individual success stories, even worksheets for every reader to fill out, to inspire everyday Americans to join the fight _wherever they live_. **_[I end the book with urgency and optimism](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1974df63-9617-462c-b4ea-1db8bb71bae6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._** While it's a tumultuous time, we have great opportunities. Trump, DeSantis and the likes of Marjorie Taylor Greene have exposed how extreme (and deep in the minority) Republicans are. This was huge in 2022, and [we must use it to forgea further comeback for American democracy in 2023 and 2024](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8cb01165-422b-46c2-9047-df5ddfaf8007/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). That’s why I rushed to finish _[Saving Democracy](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc6dc23b5-125f-418b-a80c-91af7383d1f6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_ , and humbly ask for your help. You can purchase the book[ here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4ab3a500-cf7a-489f-9231-39f4ce75df37/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) or at your local bookstore. You can also share news from [the book](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0430647e-be8b-4f1b-9179-1f6f97a7b8a1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) with folks you know and groups you're in, to ensure the message is received everywhere. As with _Laboratories_ , if you’re the organizer or member of a group fighting for democracy, I’m eager to speak to your group about _Saving Democracy_. Email me at [davidpepper4ohio@gmail.com](https://default.salsalabs.org/T106de4a0-b5a4-4063-8795-fdba4fcb55bf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) if you’re interested. Thank you, I hope to hear from you. David **Since David wrote [the book](https://default.salsalabs.org/Taa06131b-ff23-496e-995c-7a6ea76c6b9c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) it jumped to the highest selling book on democracy in the country at Amazon, even toppling Tucker Carlson (ha ha) among Amazon's new releases. [Let's keep it going](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2cddd93c-bfe5-4950-bf12-b9f42e6b5841/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)!** **You can [watch his interview with Matt Robison of the Blue Amp Channel here ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T749ac465-faff-4430-98f3-f4ff1760e65a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)to find out more about the book and its message.** Cliff

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country. — _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Negotiations for our nation's economic future
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Republicans are holding our economy hostage to force their extreme agenda.
#
Peter,
Negotiations for our nation's economic future and the current debt ceiling are well underway and we're racing towards the June 1 deadline. Republicans are holding our economy hostage to force their extreme agenda.
Republicans are trying to force through drastic cuts that could take jobs from 780,000 people, nutrition assistance from 1.2 million women, infants, and children, and Medicaid coverage from up to 21 million Americans. Surrendering to these extremist demands sets a dangerous precedent that emboldens Republicans to pursue additional, anti-democratic hostage-taking.
We can’t let that happen. That’s why I am leading the Congressional Progressive Caucus in calling on the President to consider every legislative action possible to prevent our country from defaulting and maintain critical federal support to our communities.
**But in order to make an impact, I need as much support and momentum as possible to amplify this call for action.**[**Can you add your name to our petition to support a key solution to halt major cuts to domestic priorities and put an end to Republicans' gridlock on our economy?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/stop-republicans-save-economy_2/?source=em20230525-2523&t=1&akid=2523%2E420207%2ER6ENtE)
**[Add your name ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/stop-republicans-save-economy_2/?source=em20230525-2523&t=2&akid=2523%2E420207%2ER6ENtE)**
Right-wing Republicans like Kevin McCarthy are more invested in meeting with bank executives and setting unrealistic demands including proposing deep cuts to key federal programs in exchange for raising the debt ceiling.
We can't afford to have _any_ leadership in office who would rather send our economy into a spiraling recession than raise the debt ceiling and put our country back on track. **And we can't afford to miss out on this moment to urge Republicans to set personal interests aside and show up for everyday Americans.**
[**Add your name to our petition today to ensure that our government makes the best choice for the future of working people and refuse Republicans' threat of destroying our economy.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/stop-republicans-save-economy_2/?source=em20230525-2523&t=3&akid=2523%2E420207%2ER6ENtE)
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

[**May 25, 1787:** Delegates arrived in Philadelphia to meet in the old state house (now called Independence Hall) with the original goal of revising the Articles of Confederation. Under the influence of James Madison and Alexander Hamilton, the group began to lay the framework for an entirely new system of government. By September, they had created the United States Constitution and created the American government as we know it today. ](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=c43a4cf00429447ea485c79914e919e3&_e=6MRxj0oC5VJbdlptcrGNpYV6MB0tZQ9vcqtFa5rYAko_qZ_wJ1h14pZ3dwtQ0jYIHOmgTzEsgaFwaIUfcftaG6X5XIdiBEndwx3NJv79nK24qRFuaibDaM5ypmGt8BqNwmMl_9_1PkLLuvZZbl1CcmrsPI3VplZhbRLfO3kz8P97F6kBofCrrNy5WF2HS5G41GwuPenmebt0sQ-_Jft_DHNAnQkj-1FxCpP4NViydVDngN_iivmuH0M99-iirQ5tvb3pzA-D5WT1xLtAHOZGiQ%3D%3D) **Source -[wikipedia.org](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=c43a4cf00429447ea485c79914e919e3&_e=6MRxj0oC5VJbdlptcrGNpYV6MB0tZQ9vcqtFa5rYAko_qZ_wJ1h14pZ3dwtQ0jYIHOmgTzEsgaFwaIUfcftaG6X5XIdiBEndwx3NJv79nK3le78OQaKc0YY_8lqzxC7lJc8BmopQniPowDBaRzHZhIlJuWSAhJmvlyB507jlkUJgp2qbfO3x0b0yc1ZHgcn4SmUKOkhEXLClXR5L7X9hXyS6FkZOP9TPctQJVEIk_NQ9qdY933EpC37MuUmwATMf6GE9uC2vVr7y_G4slB4sJA%3D%3D)[](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=c43a4cf00429447ea485c79914e919e3&_e=6MRxj0oC5VJbdlptcrGNpbsTvEdT9_9Pzid7GYq8s52QnhAaqkpLq2zBZUT8-Z8QrlS75YO1sONaPnoSjEi1RNsPOthtaYTlOdFilRwfAbSbRn3iCnu2rcsMAJZtoT40eFWny77kx2Rv7PZWMXT5qN7dbRjgMrZtSyrSr-B-ClhoRQB2rttXCUzCwOROiY495afCMPIWxwrAJUS2gPhJOfBRsW3mD6DyP6Lxj-li1RBryhRT6dirXPwWfAXiNTOR)**

[**May 25, 1961:** President John F. Kennedy delivered a special message to a joint session of Congress on ‘Urgent National Needs.’ The main point of his address was “I believe we should go to the moon.” He listed several other national priorities, but emphasized "First, I believe that this nation should commit itself to achieving the goal, before this decade is out, of landing a man on the moon and returning him safely to the earth." ](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=c43a4cf00429447ea485c79914e919e3&_e=6MRxj0oC5VJbdlptcrGNpcKN6cXT6FfEuL8dXboM89Vuqm2t3txw50b856BEuAnKouxB68jbBQEsnBSSEFghr-aP7HZsE8pbyV_jbP-Jbh-Mt5ZVTThb7OJcyM-kS9Vz0WYwiRGp2clBB1WPU3u_vs68o1eTR0SYAjg5ix-QeWjVRY0mpP4Gxta6PqxxwAk4dtLdO6Bniad2JBNQpU8n3uPuP2JYNuNahG3a1VAjKvFlI00ghZ_q0rwR2vkzdIZmQzjH6BfGqXAynZUWrqaED_tds13WYyX26pGJ646TwjkW7vF8IHecJZ4p-TJLfCoZ) **Source -[jfklibrary.org](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=c43a4cf00429447ea485c79914e919e3&_e=6MRxj0oC5VJbdlptcrGNpcKN6cXT6FfEuL8dXboM89Vuqm2t3txw50b856BEuAnKouxB68jbBQEsnBSSEFghr-aP7HZsE8pbyV_jbP-Jbh-Mt5ZVTThb7OJcyM-kS9Vz0WYwiRGp2clBB1WPU3u_vs68o1eTR0SYAjg5ix-QeWhwf0CublJQtIUjlr8Rt85vN1cW7EqXmi3tQ47_vGHhFxeOjiCMcf_QhJzxoeJsu0KmO4g86kHpPNjkVsmGgMMcw05Fg1wFomQ492_8fL4u129c88_lJ1j9fFUlSECPbiG4jgV4zemcS1jgNptX8p9R)**

[**May 25, 1977:** George Lucas’s space opera film, Star Wars, was released in a limited number of theaters in the United States. Lucas wasn’t anticipating a high level of success for the space movie, especially with other highly-anticipated movies premiering that same summer, but it quickly broke box office records and had lines of people waiting for tickets outside theaters.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=c43a4cf00429447ea485c79914e919e3&_e=6MRxj0oC5VJbdlptcrGNpYV6MB0tZQ9vcqtFa5rYAkrIlo7VdtKVIA5MCDwJrivIQ69P4f6ZjFLiLaLTSfwah9n3F0H_1JVjIi6dH-lA6xQcXdgsrQwyq4cLu0oVBafM5hIqAmg4I6e6fbpX6WjSCTuDqDbKEZXmn_115a7LHZTNP4RQwjNwnOniayTPM94Ci9FbNmdQb48WjAaYp0tCssMwt3XdcjjMolHQvL5r-XPrDNiRLeHY2V7DL1ababvp) **Source -[wikipedia.org](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=c43a4cf00429447ea485c79914e919e3&_e=6MRxj0oC5VJbdlptcrGNpYV6MB0tZQ9vcqtFa5rYAkrIlo7VdtKVIA5MCDwJrivIQ69P4f6ZjFLiLaLTSfwah1Y1y3thiwdyFyaM-0BxbooliLFTVLrcKMKBW3sbLWMN6dtZOEvwza0KwHh3hPTArxjTo6IGR1cbcjRdBR037f-6zcpfmi7RxgqBb2J7Uc_9cbS1l3UnWM2h9T4hypS-JiieilyY05QSGxaNQdPXIbqhsSdim7JYO98Uy7mhkZcT)**

Team — what’s happening in Washington right now is unacceptable. Threats to default and crash our economy. Playing politics with veterans’ health care. Hello,
After the 2022 election, my husband Adam Frisch and I went to Washington for “freshman orientation” for new members of Congress.
We still didn’t know whether or not Adam had defeated Lauren Boebert. We were in the middle of a recount – and Adam was down by only a few hundred votes.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/63814911/408113484/1610638071?refcode=em20230525pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=d2d7829e-3ffb-ed11-907c-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMmQ3ODI5ZS0zZmZiLWVkMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L2LrxXn_tIm3q-gYQGglxlMnpQZxaPEmW9P7t_JW3Ro=)

Now, Adam’s running again in 2024 – and this time, I know he can win. But first, we have to fix the reason he so narrowly lost in 2022.
**During the last campaign, we got out-spent by Lauren Boebert and her Super PACs – by millions and millions of dollars.** It wasn’t that we didn’t put in the work (we did). It wasn’t that Adam didn’t have a positive vision for the district (he does). We were just drowned out in millions of dollars of lie-filled attack ads.
You see, Lauren Boebert is one of the best fundraisers in Congress. Her extreme, far-right base funnels millions to her campaign. But Adam doesn’t take money from corporate PACs – never has, never will.
**If Adam’s going to be able to finish the job and defeat Lauren Boebert this time, we cannot afford to get out-spent again – and we’re counting on your help now.**
**We’ve set a goal to raise another $250,000 before our end-of-May deadline, but right now, we still have $83,164 left to raise.**

clean_body: During the last campaign, we got out-spent by Lauren Boebert and her Super PACs – by millions and millions of dollars. Hello, After the 2022 election, my husband Adam Frisch and I went to Washington for “freshman orientation” for new members of Congress. We still didn’t know whether or not Adam had defeated Lauren Boebert. We were in the middle of a recount – and Adam was down by only a few hundred votes. = Ultimately, though, after all the votes were counted, Adam came up short. We lost to Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. Now, Adam’s running again in 2024 – and this time, I know he can win. But first, we have to fix the reason he so narrowly lost in 2022. During the last campaign, we got out-spent by Lauren Boebert and her Super PACs – by millions and millions of dollars. It wasn’t that we didn’t put in the work (we did). It wasn’t that Adam didn’t have a positive vision for the district (he does). We were just drowned out in millions of dollars of lie-filled attack ads. You see, Lauren Boebert is one of the best fundraisers in Congress. Her extreme, far-right base funnels millions to her campaign. But Adam doesn’t take money from corporate PACs – never has, never will. If Adam’s going to be able to finish the job and defeat Lauren Boebert this time, we cannot afford to get out-spent again – and we’re counting on your help now. We’ve set a goal to raise another $250,000 before our end-of-May deadline, but right now, we still have $83,164 left to raise. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I’ll admit, the first campaign was hard – for the whole family. Peter,
Good news: We’ve received an incredible amount of support since this campaign began, and that support has only grown with each passing day!
Nashvillians are ready to elect a mayor who will put our city first.
Even with all of this support, Axios Nashville is saying this race is:
“perhaps the most up-in-the-air race anyone can remember”
Peter, the ONLY public poll has us in the lead now, but we have to work to maintain our momentum and reach the **majority** of voters who are undecided. We have an End of Month Fundraising Deadline coming up around the corner, and we have to raise $12,374 more to set us up for success in the August 3rd election. We led with our good news, but here's the bad news:
Nashville is up against a hostile takeover from the state and I’m up against a self-funded millionaire opponent.
Not only that, but as our End of Month Fundraising Deadline approaches, we've been running the reports and our numbers aren’t where they need to be right now.

As mayor, Heidi established a track record for fiscal discipline, balancing the budget every year of her Mayorship, eliminating my own salary, and returning $2M to my city’s reserves.
Heidi was elected in November of 2020 to represent District 20 in the Tennessee State Senate. Since then, she’s been an outspoken advocate for science, the LGBTQ community, public education, local control, women's and kids' issues, Medicaid expansion, and the environment.
Heidi sponsored or co-sponsored over 100 pieces of legislation in her first year in the senate, including legislation to allow cities to offer paid family leave, increase funding for school counselors and reading interventionists, and make it easier to cast a vote.
Heidi is focused on sustainable infrastructure, economic development and job creation, fully funding our public schools and supporting educators, expanding access to affordable healthcare, investing in suicide prevention, making certain that vulnerable children in state custody are not falling through the cracks, and ensuring that every Tennessean - regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age or ability - can achieve the American Dream.

A list of events that got more views than Ron DeSantis:
#
Last night, Ron DeSantis announced that he’s officially running for president on a Twitter live conversation with Elon Musk. If you missed it, you’re not alone.
The online event had a ton of technical malfunctions and, in the end, his launch got just 300,000 views. For context, Alexandria got 430,000 views when she decided on-the-fly to stream a video game on Twitch.
**Here’s a quick list of events that got more views than DeSantis’ campaign launch, according to MSNBC:
**
While DeSantis’ (failure to) launch might be funny, his policies are not: He led the effort to ban teaching critical race theory in schools in Florida, signed the “Don’t Say Gay” bill into law, just signed a truly draconian and inhumane immigration bill into law, and has attacked reproductive freedom by implementing an abortion ban after six weeks.
**Alexandria is fighting to directly combat Republicans like Ron DeSantis. She’s not afraid to take on right-wing extremists.**

clean_body: I thought this was worth talking about. | Peter, as you may already know, my Mamaw helped raise me to be the man I am today and had a certain way of putting things in perspective that no one else on Earth could. I want to share something she told me one day and hope it resonates with you the same way it did with me. " Everyone in the world is one of three kinds. A good Terminator, a bad Terminator, and neutral." To me, that comes down to you deciding what you want to be regardless of whatever hardwiring you think you have. As for me, my Mamaw instilled in me the value of hard work and never letting your situation dictate what you can be - as long as you put the effort into whatever you're doing. That's why I'm fighting day in and day out to make sure every single kid in Ohio and across America has every opportunity to succeed. That's why I'm fighting like hell to stop the Socialist Agenda that wants to make you think you're a victim and that the world is against you. No. As my Mamaw taught me, you'll go as far as you're willing to work to get there. That's why I hope you'll join me today in my fight for a better tomorrow by rushing anything you can below so we can have an America to pass on to our kids and grandkids where they know that anything they put their mind to they can achieve. | God Bless, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. body:
Today, the Supreme Court delivered a significant blow to our environment and the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) with a 5 to 4 decision that curtails the agency's ability to regulate America's water.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim?refcode=2023-05-25-scotus-cleanwater&recurring=&amount=9&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=1c7ade0e-46fb-ed11-907c-00224832eb73 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim?refcode=2023-05-25-scotus-cleanwater&recurring=&amount=9&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=1c7ade0e-46fb-ed11-907c-00224832eb73]

This ruling, influenced by corporate interests, emboldens polluters and further erodes people's trust that the Supreme Court is looking out for their best interests.

The majority of Americans recognize clean water is becoming less and less accessible, and decisions like this only serve to undermine the perception of impartiality among our Justices.

Protecting our environment and our drinking water should not be a partisan issue. But, unfortunately, Congressional Republicans and right-wing judges have made it one by relying on outdated arguments to oppose environmental protection and climate solutions, and pander to corporate polluters.

Last year, every single Republican voted against the Inflation Reduction Act, the most significant climate investment in U.S. history, claiming it would damage our economy. But, in reality, the landmark legislation created nine million clean energy jobs and introduced tax credits that bolstered our economy while continuing our work to protect our environment.

Republican leaders remain stuck in the past, tethered to the corporate polluters that support their campaigns, and their appointed Supreme Court Justices are following suit with this regressive decision.

As leaders, we have the responsibility to leave our country better than we found it.

People deserve clean drinking water and protection from corporate polluters, not the other way around.

Climate change is no longer a distant threat. We need to act now.

For the sake of future generations, we must stand up to the corporate polluters that have far too much influence in Washington.

I will uphold my commitment to progress and continue to work toward real climate solutions.

More soon,

Andy

| | Peter, can I share something with you?

When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service, but I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/63816654/408118787/2063583167?refcode=20230525.2_TB_5AX&amount=20&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjJmYWMxYS00N2ZiLWVkMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eIP2Q_SSXGtIhbnP7PF54GXSM4EI5vgZ-5hk6Qex9Fc=)

Seeing others in the LGBTQ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love — I came to realize that I could do both. **I could run for office and be honest about who I am. And that’s exactly what I did.**

When I became the first openly gay Senator in our nation's history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. And from lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act,_ I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that.

That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too. Now, I'm asking you to keep going:

[**_Will you help me continue to make a difference by splitting a donation between my reelection campaign and the Democratic Party of Georgia today?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/63816655/408118788/2063583167?refcode=20230525.2_TB_5AX&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjJmYWMxYS00N2ZiLWVkMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eIP2Q_SSXGtIhbnP7PF54GXSM4EI5vgZ-5hk6Qex9Fc=)

Over the years, we have made incredible progress in the fight for equality. But Peter, we cannot mistake that progress for a total victory.

Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, especially targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ youth.

And when the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade,_ Justice Clarence Thomas called for _Obergefell v. Hodges_ — the case that established nationwide marriage equality — to be “reconsidered.”

[**_For all of the progress we have made, there is still a LOT more to be done. I’ll keep up the fight as long as I can, and I’m hoping you’ll support our important work by splitting a donation between my reelection campaign and the Democratic Party of Georgia today._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/63816656/408118789/2063583167?refcode=20230525.2_TB_5AX&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjJmYWMxYS00N2ZiLWVkMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eIP2Q_SSXGtIhbnP7PF54GXSM4EI5vgZ-5hk6Qex9Fc=)

clean_body: We need to educate base Democratic voters and turn them out to vote "NO" = | I have an important update for you, team. Republican politicians in Ohio want to make it essentially impossible for voters to amend our state constitution. Their bill, which will be on the August 8 ballot as “Issue 1,” would require that any proposed amendment to the Ohio Constitution get at least 60% of votes instead of a simple majority — and that would effectively end citizen-led ballot initiatives. Ohio Republicans sold out our constitution to corrupt politicians and out-of-state billionaires, but voters will get the final say on Issue 1 on August 8. We need your help to increase the knowledge of base Democratic voters and turn them out to vote "NO." We're counting on your support to fuel our efforts: = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = = = = Look, I want to make one thing perfectly clear, team: This brazen attempt to silence Ohio voters is an affront to our democratic principles and an attack on our collective ability to shape the policies that impact our lives. This is why we need your support to fight back. Our VOTE "NO" campaign aims to inform Ohioans about the implications of this proposal and rally support to save citizen-led initiatives, the voices of everyday Ohioans. Every dollar you contribute makes a difference. = Thank you, Liz Walters Chair Ohio Democrats The Ohio Democratic Party is working year-round to elect Democrats who will fight for working families all over the Buckeye State.
